en.season_badge: 🚣 Ferry Historical Journey · Thousand-Year Pine Forest
en.source_book: Featured in Official Gangwon-Yeongwol Tourism Guide 'Yeongwol Journey'
en.title: Yeongwol Cheongnyeongpo Cape, King Danjong's Forest Surrounded by Water
en.subtitle: Gwangcheon-ri, Nam-myeon, Yeongwol-gun, Gangwon (Scenic Site No. 50)
en.pull_quote: A secluded inland island accessible only by boat; ancient pine groves and the majestic Gwaneumsong tree quietly witnessing a young king's tragic exile.
paragraphs: Located along the winding Seogang River in the upper reaches of the Namhangang River, Cheongnyeongpo Cape is surrounded by deep water on three sides and flanked by the sheer cliffs of Yukyukbong Peak to the west. Accessible solely by ferry, this naturally secluded sanctuary is where King Danjong, the 6th monarch of the Joseon Dynasty, was exiled after his dethronement.

Stepping off the short ferry ride, visitors are welcomed by a dense pine grove carrying centuries of history and the venerable Gwaneumsong Pine Tree (Natural Monument No. 349). Ascending to Manghyangtap Pagoda and Nosandae Cliff, the tranquil currents of the Seogang River blend with autumn leaves and pine fragrance, leaving a deeply resonant impression.

ja.subtitle: 江原道寧越郡南面広川里（名勝第50号）
ja.address: 江原特別自治道寧越郡南面清冷浦路133
ja.pull_quote: 舟でしか辿り着けない陸の孤島。幼き王の歳月を静かに見守ってきた大木「観音松」と豊かな松林
paragraphs: 南漢江の上流、西江（ソガン）が蛇行して流れる清冷浦は、東・南・北の三方が深い川に囲まれ、西側には険しい六六峰の岩壁がそびえ立つため、舟に乗らなければ立ち入ることのできない天然の要塞のような地形です。朝鮮第6代国王・端宗（タンジョン）が王位を追われ、魯山君に降格されて流刑生活を送った歴史の舞台でもあります。
短い渡し舟を渡って島に足を踏み入れると、数百年の歳月を刻んだ鬱蒼とした松林と天然記念物第349号の観音松が旅人を迎えます。望郷塔や魯山台に登れば、静かにたゆたう西江の流れと紅葉、清らかな松の香りが心に深い余韻を残します。

zh.title: 寧越清泠浦，三面環水的端宗幽居之林
zh.subtitle: 江原道寧越郡南面廣川里（名勝第50號）
zh.address: 江原特別自治道寧越郡南面清泠浦路133
zh.pull_quote: 非乘船無法抵達的陸中孤島，參天古松「觀音松」與蒼鬱松林，默默見證了年幼君王的流放歲月
paragraphs: 流經南漢江上游西江的清泠浦，東、南、北三面皆被深邃江水環繞，西面則是險峻壁立的六六峰岩壁，形成非乘船不得進出的天然絕境。這裡是朝鮮第6代君王端宗痛失王位、降封為魯山君後的幽居之地，見證了一段令人惋惜的歷史。
搭乘短暫的渡船踏上島嶼，迎面而來的是蘊含數百年歲月的茂密松林，以及被指定為天然紀念物第349號的觀音松。登上望鄉塔與魯山臺，靜靜流淌的西江波光、秋葉與松林幽香交織，留下悠遠綿長的回韻。

en.title: Suncheonman Bay Wetland, Golden Reed Fields Swaying in the Sunset Breeze
en.subtitle: 513-25 Suncheonman-gil, Suncheon-si (UNESCO World Natural Heritage)
en.pull_quote: Korea's premier ecological garden where hooded cranes soar over endless golden reed waves and the S-shaped tidal channel glows in evening crimson.
paragraphs: Gently cradled by the Goheung and Yeosu peninsulas, Suncheonman Bay is an expansive coastal wetland spanning over 75 km². From autumn through winter, vast colonies of tall golden reeds sway like shimmering silver waves, creating a magnificent spectacle.

Strolling along the barrier-free wooden boardwalks accessible to strollers and wheelchairs, visitors can observe thriving mudflats brimming with crabs and mudskippers. An easy climb up to Yongsan Observatory unveils an unforgettable sunset descending across the iconic S-shaped waterway.

ja.pull_quote: 見渡す限り広がる黄金の葦の波の上をナベヅルが舞い、S字の干潟水路が夕茜に染まる韓国屈指の生態庭園
paragraphs: 高興（コフン）半島と麗水（ヨス）半島に優しく抱かれた順天湾は、総面積75㎢を超える広大な沿岸湿地です。秋から冬にかけては、人の背丈を優に超える黄金色の葦の群落が銀色の波のように揺らめき、壮大な景観を生み出します。
ベビーカーや車椅子でも快適に行き来できる平坦なバリアフリー木道デッキを歩きながら、カニやトビハゼが息づく干潟を間近に観察できます。なだらかな山道を登り龍山（ヨンサン）展望台に立てば、順天湾特有のS字水路を赤く染める忘れられない日没に出会えます。

paragraphs: 順天灣被高興半島與麗水半島溫柔環抱，是一片面積超過75平方公里的廣袤沿海濕地。從秋季到冬季，高過人頭的金色蘆葦群落宛如銀色波浪般起伏擺動，展現無比壯觀的景致。
沿著嬰兒車與輪椅皆能輕鬆通行的平坦無障礙木棧道漫步，近距離觀察泥灘中活躍的招潮蟹與彈塗魚；沿著緩緩的山徑登上龍山觀景臺，更能俯瞰夕陽沉入順天灣標誌性S型水道的絕美景致。

en.season_badge: 🌫️ Dawn Water Mist · Willow Tree Geological Gem
en.source_book: Featured in Cheongsong UNESCO Global Geopark Guidebook
en.title: Cheongsong Jusanji Reservoir, Mornings with 300-Year-Old Willows Resting on Water
en.subtitle: Jusanji-ri, Juwangsan-myeon, Cheongsong-gun, Gyeongbuk (Scenic Site No. 105)
en.pull_quote: A mystical mountain reservoir built in 1721 that has never dried up, weaving a watercolor morning of submerged King Willows and ethereal water mist.
paragraphs: Completed in 1721 during the reign of Joseon King Gyeongjong, Jusanji Reservoir rests atop dense welded tuff formations formed from volcanic ash. For over 300 years, this enchanting mountain pond has never run dry or exposed its bottom, even through the severest droughts.

In the early morning when delicate mist drifts low across the water, over twenty centuries-old King Willows rooted deep in the lake cast serene reflections upon the mirror-like surface, quietly drawing photographers and travelers year-round.

ja.address: 慶尚北道青松郡周王山面注山池里73
ja.pull_quote: 1721年の築造以来一度も底を現したことがない神秘の池。水中に根を張るヤナギと朝霧が描く水彩画の世界
paragraphs: 朝鮮時代の景宗元年（1721年）に完成した注山池は、緻密な火山灰が固まってできた「溶結凝灰岩」の地層の上に築かれ、300年以上の歴史の中でどれほど深刻な日照りが訪れても一度も水が枯れて底を現したことがない神秘の山中湖です。
特に水面から静かに朝霧が立ちのぼる早朝、水中に深く根を下ろして枝を広げた樹齢数百年のマルバヤナギ約20本が鏡のような湖面に映り込み、四季を通じて写真家や旅人の足を惹きつけてやみません。

zh.title: 青松注山池，守候水面三百載的王柳古木清晨
zh.subtitle: 慶尚北道青松郡周王山面注山池里（名勝第105號）
zh.address: 慶尚北道青松郡周王山面注山池里73
zh.pull_quote: 自1721年修建以來從未乾涸見底的神祕高山蓄水池，扎根水中的王柳與靜謐水霧交織出的夢幻水彩畫
paragraphs: 注山池竣工於朝鮮景宗元年（1721年），坐落在由緻密火山灰凝固形成的「熔結凝灰岩」地層之上。歷經300多年的漫長歲月，無論遭遇多麼嚴重的乾旱，這座神奇的池塘從未枯竭見底。
特別是在清晨薄霧貼著水面冉冉升起時，二十多棵樹齡數百年的王柳深扎池底、垂下枝椏，在鏡面般澄澈的水面上倒映出夢幻身影，一年四季都吸引著無數攝影愛好者與旅人悄然造訪。

en.season_badge: 🍂 Autumn & Early Winter Eco Forest Trail
en.source_book: Featured in Jangsu County Official Guidebook 《Jangsu Travel》 p.9
en.title: Tteunbongsaem Spring, Source of the Geumgang River
en.subtitle: 10-18 Mulppuraengi-gil, Jangsu-gun (Geumgang Love Water Experience Center)
en.pull_quote: Where King Taejo Yi Seong-gye witnessed a mythical phoenix soaring on a five-colored rainbow and received the omen to found the Joseon Dynasty — the very headwaters of the Geumgang River flowing 397.25 km to the West Sea.
paragraphs: Ascending 1.5 km along the valley of Sinmusan Mountain in Subun Village brings you to Tteunbongsaem Spring, the ultimate source of the Geumgang River. Legend tells that King Taejo Yi Seong-gye, founder of the Joseon Dynasty, offered prayers here and received a divine revelation to establish the new dynasty after seeing a phoenix rise into the sky atop a rainbow.

From this quiet spring, the stream journeys 397.25 km all the way to the West Sea estuary. The surrounding Tteunbongsaem Ecological Park features the Geumgang Love Water Experience Center, native wildflower colonies, an eco-playground, an ecological greenhouse, and forest trails. Showcasing endangered species, amphibians, and reptiles, it offers visitors enriching ecological education and memorable outdoor experiences.

ja.title: 錦江の始まり、トゥンボンセム（飛鳳泉）発源地
ja.subtitle: 長水郡ムルプレンイキル 10-18（錦江サラン水体験館）
ja.address: 全北特別自治道 長水郡 長水邑 ムルプレンイキル 10-18
ja.pull_quote: 朝鮮の太祖・李成桂が五色の虹に乗って飛び立つ鳳凰を見て建国の啓示を受けた地 — 西海まで397.25kmを流れる錦江の最初の一滴
paragraphs: 水分（スブン）マウルの神舞山（シンムサン）渓谷を1.5kmほど登ると、錦江（クムガン）の源流であるトゥンボンセム（飛鳳泉）が現れます。朝鮮王朝を開いた李成桂が虹に乗って昇る鳳凰を目撃し、天地神明から建国の啓示を授かったという伝説が伝わる神聖な泉です。
トゥンボンセムから湧き出た水筋は、西海（黄海）河口まで397.25kmにわたり流れます。周辺のトゥンボンセム生態公園には、錦江サラン水体験館をはじめ、自生野草群生地、生態遊び場、生態温室、森林散策道が整備され、絶滅危惧種や両生類・爬虫類なども展示されており、生態体験と環境教育の場として親しまれています。

zh.title: 錦江第一滴水，飛鳳泉源頭
zh.subtitle: 長水郡水根路 10-18（錦江之愛水體驗館）
zh.address: 全北特別自治道長水郡長水邑水根路 10-18
zh.pull_quote: 朝鮮太祖李成桂因目睹鳳凰乘五色長虹騰空而獲得開國啟示之地——奔流397.25公里入黃海的錦江之源
paragraphs: 沿著水分村神舞山的山谷向上攀登1.5公里，便能抵達錦江的源頭「飛鳳泉（Tteunbongsaem）」。這裡不僅是孕育錦江的起點，更流傳著朝鮮開國君主李成桂在此虔誠祈禱時，看見鳳凰踏著彩虹翱翔天際，因而獲得天地神明開國啟示的傳奇神話。
自飛鳳泉湧出的清泉，一路奔流397.25公里抵達西海河口。周邊闢建的飛鳳泉生態公園內，設有錦江之愛水體驗館、野生花卉群落、生態遊樂場、生態溫室與林蔭步道，並展示各類瀕危動植物與兩棲爬行類，為旅人提供了寓教於樂的生態體驗殿堂。

en.pull_quote: Beneath soaring, majestic Norway spruces reaching toward the sky, immerse yourself in the serene, deep breath of the forest across all four seasons.
paragraphs: Nestled beside Deogyusan National Park and Gucheondong Valley, Deogyusan Natural Recreation Forest offers deep woodland relaxation throughout the year: vibrant royal azaleas in spring, crystal-clear streams in summer, fiery autumn foliage on Jeoksangsan Mountain, and breathtaking rime frost with snowy vistas in winter.

The recreation forest is densely populated with Japanese larches and Korean pines, alongside its signature highlight: a magnificent Norway spruce forest planted in 1931. Soaring gracefully toward the heavens with an exotic, grand ambiance, the gentle woodland trails allow anyone to enjoy a rejuvenating phytoncide walk.

paragraphs: 徳裕山（トギュサン）自然休養林は、徳裕山国立公園と九千洞（クチョンドン）渓谷に隣接し、春のツツジ群落、夏の清らかな渓流、秋の赤裳山（チョクサンサン）の紅葉、冬の雪景色と霧氷まで、四季折々の奥深い森林リラクゼーションを提供します。
場内にはカラマツやチョウセンゴヨウがうっそうと生い茂り、中でも1931年に植林され天高く伸びた名物「ドイツトウヒ（欧州唐檜）の森」は異国情緒と雄大な景観を誇ります。なだらかな木道を歩きながら、清々しいフィトンチッドの森林浴を満喫できます。

paragraphs: 德裕山自然休養林鄰近德裕山國立公園與九千洞溪谷，春季山躑躅花海盛放、夏季九千洞溪水澄澈沁涼、秋季赤裳山楓紅似火，冬季則有銀白雪景與晶瑩樹冰，一年四季皆為滌蕩身心的山林勝地。
園區內落葉松與紅松林鬱鬱蔥蔥，其中於1931年造林、傲然挺拔的招牌地標「歐洲雲杉林」，洋溢著異國風情與雄偉氣魄。步道平緩舒適，漫步其間可盡情吸納清新的森林芬多精。

en.source_book: Featured in Jeonnam & Gangjin Official Guidebook 《Namdo Travel Guide》
en.title: Gangjin Mandeoksan Baengnyeonsa Camellia Forest & Dasan Trail
en.subtitle: 145 Baengnyeonsa-gil, Doam-myeon, Gangjin-gun (Natural Monument No. 151)
en.pull_quote: An 800-meter woodland trail where Dasan Jeong Yak-yong and Master Hyejang strolled to share tea and philosophy, embraced by 1,500 native camellia trees.
paragraphs: Surrounding the historic Baengnyeonsa Temple—where Venerable Wonmyo organized the White Lotus Society during the Goryeo Dynasty—thrives a lush forest of around 1,500 indigenous camellia trees designated as Natural Monument No. 151. Beginning to bud as crisp winds arrive in late autumn and early winter, they carpet the tranquil path with crimson blossoms well into early spring.

Passing through a 7-meter-high camellia canopy toward Dasan Chodang thatched house, this serene hillside path is where renowned scholar Dasan Jeong Yak-yong walked daily during his exile to meet Master Hyejang. Along this path of contemplation, visitors are treated to panoramic views overlooking the placid waters of Gangjin Bay.

高さ約7mのツバキのトンネルを抜けて茶山草堂へと続く静かな山腹の小道は、流刑生活中の茶山・丁若鏞（チョン・ヤギョン）が白蓮社の恵蔵禅師に会うため日々歩いた思索の道です。歩みを進めると、穏やかに広がる南道・康津湾の海景色を一望できます。

paragraphs: 在高麗時期圓妙國師發起白蓮結社的歷史名剎白蓮社周邊，生長著約1,500株被指定為天然紀念物第151號的原生冬柏（山茶）樹林。每年深秋至初冬冷風初起時結苞，直至早春將鮮紅欲滴的花朵灑滿靜謐山徑。
穿過高約7公尺的山茶樹綠色隧道通往茶山草堂，這條隱於半山腰的清幽小徑，是茶山丁若鏞先生在流放歲月裡，每日為造訪白蓮社惠藏禪師所漫步的深思之路；登高處更能將南道康津灣平靜蔚藍的海灣風光盡收眼底。

今回の祭りは江原道の伝統文化を中心に、地域芸術家に創作の機会を提供し、市民の文化享有権の増進と観光活性化を図るために企画された。来る11月26日から28日までの3日間開催される2026ダンダンダンフェスティバルでは、耳を魅了する独歩的な叙事、全世代を合唱と共感へと導く天才シンガーソングライター、アン・イェウンと、伝統と現代の最も破格的な衝突を見せるこの時代最も独歩的なネオトラディショナルバンド、チュダヘチャジスの招待公演をはじめ、江陵の5つの団体に所属する子どもや青少年が参加するふれあい伝統演戯マダン、江原の4つの公演チームが共にするステージ、さらに国楽人のナム・サンイル、アニメーションクルー（アメリカズ・ゴット・タレントTOP10、コリアズ・ゴット・タレントTOP3）、キム・ダハムトリオ、パク・ジンオ（JINO）、歴代霊山紅チャレンジ受賞チームや地域の芸術家たちが参加する霊山紅コンサートまで、豊かな公演を楽しむことができる。

Visitors can also hear stories about Joseon Dynasty jobs held by figures in Jeollagamyeong.

Gyeonggi-do...
en.pull_quote: Munsan-eup, Paju-si, Gyeonggi-do Seasonal Recommended Festival · DMZ Area, Gyeonggi-do (2026.10.12 ~ 2026.11.29)
paragraphs: The DMZ OPEN Festival is Gyeonggi-do's representative comprehensive cultural event designed to allow visitors to experience the peace, ecological, and historical values of the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) through arts, academia, and various other methods. Moving away from viewing the DMZ merely as a space of division and military tension, it reinterprets the long-preserved ecological environment, historical significance, and possibilities of peace and coexistence through today's cultural language.

Gyeonggi-do has expanded the concept of 'OPEN' with the meaning of transforming the 'closed DMZ' into a space open to everyone, and the festival is operated as a multi-cultural event showcasing programs of various genres over a long period. The DMZ OPEN Festival aims to be a festival where visitors don't just look at the DMZ, but walk, listen, see, think, and experience it firsthand. By connecting various programs such as arts, academia, and sports into a single flow, we aim to share the peace, ecological, and historical values of the DMZ, and further create an open cultural arena to discover the meaning of 'greater peace' together.

paragraphs: DMZ OPEN Festivalは、非武装地帯（DMZ）が持つ平和・生態・歴史的価値を芸術、学術など多様な方法で体験できるよう構成した京畿道の代表的な複合文化行事である。単にDMZを分断と軍事的緊張の空間として見ることから脱却し、長年保存されてきた生態環境と歴史的意味、平和と共生の可能性を今日の文化的言語で再解釈する。

en.title: Lee Jae-myung's Place of Action
en.overview: Lee Jae-myung's Place of Action is where the young activist Lee Jae-myung attempted to assassinate the pro-Japanese traitor Lee Wan-yong on December 22, 1909. As Lee Wan-yong arrogantly passed by in a rickshaw, Lee Jae-myung lunged at him with a dagger, shouting 'Long live Korean independence!' He was captured and fatally injured by the police's swords, dying on September 30, 1910. To honor Lee Jae-myung, a commemorative stone was installed by the city of Seoul.

en.title: Paris Park
en.overview: Paris Park was established in 1986 based on an agreement between Korea and France to commemorate the 100th anniversary of diplomatic relations, creating squares in each other's capitals. Some areas of the park are designed as 'Paris Square,' symbolizing France. Major facilities include Seoul Square, a pond, and Paris Square, while the Han-French Square is designed to harmonize Korean and French cultures. Seoul Square features a floor design with the Samtaegeuk pattern, murals, and a wall fountain, embodying tradition and symbolism.

zh.overview: 巴黎公园是为了纪念与法国建交100周年而于1986年根据两国达成的协议而设立的，双方在各自首都建立广场。公园内部分区域被装饰为象征法国的“巴黎广场”。主要设施包括首尔广场、池塘和巴黎广场，而韩法广场则旨在使韩国和法国文化和谐共存。首尔广场设有三太极图案的地面设计、壁画和墙泉，体现了传统性和象征性。

en.title: Pohang International Fireworks Festival
en.overview: *The festival food details below are from the previous year (2025), and the 2026 festival food details are currently being updated.* Pohang, the 'City of Fire and Light,' hosts the Pohang International Fireworks Festival, a representative cultural tourism festival held annually. Originating from a fireworks show held in 2004 to commemorate Pohang Citizens' Day, the festival takes as its themes the industrial 'light' symbolizing the world-class steel city of Pohang and the 'fire' of its hot blast furnaces.
en.pull_quote: Buk-gu, Pohang-si, Gyeongbuk Seasonal Recommended Festival · Yeongildae Beach (2026.11.19 ~ 2026.11.21)
paragraphs: *The festival food details below are from the previous year (2025), and the 2026 festival food details are currently being updated.* Pohang, the 'City of Fire and Light,' hosts the Pohang International Fireworks Festival, a representative cultural tourism festival held annually. Originating from a fireworks show held in 2004 to commemorate Pohang Citizens' Day, the festival takes as its themes the industrial 'light' symbolizing the world-class steel city of Pohang and the 'fire' of its hot blast furnaces.

Since then, it has grown into an international-scale festival, showcasing various spectacles including an international fireworks show featuring famous fireworks teams from around the world. Recently, moving away from simple fireworks-centric events, it has expanded diverse contents combining industry and culture/art, such as media facades and night parades. Moreover, developing into a participatory festival enjoyed together by citizens and tourists utilizing Pohang's marine scenery and urban space, it has established itself as a representative cultural tourism festival that enhances Pohang's urban brand and night tourism competitiveness.

ja.title: 浦項国際不빛(光)祭り
ja.addr: 慶尚北道浦項市北区海岸路 48 (港口洞)
ja.overview: *以下の祭りの食べ物に関する内容は前年度(2025年)のものであり、2026年度の食べ物内容は現在アップデート中です。*「火と光の都市」浦項では毎年、代表的な文化観光祭りである浦項国際不光祭りが開催される。浦項国際不光祭りは、世界的な鉄鋼都市・浦項を象徴する産業の「光」と熱い溶鉱炉の「火」をテーマに、2004年の浦項市民の日を記念して開催された花火ショーから始まった。
ja.pull_quote: 慶北浦項市北区 季節のおすすめ祭り · 迎日台海水浴場 (2026.11.19 ~ 2026.11.21)
paragraphs: *以下の祭りの食べ物に関する内容は前年度(2025年)のものであり、2026年度の食べ物内容は現在アップデート中です。*「火と光の都市」浦項では毎年、代表的な文化観光祭りである浦項国際不光祭りが開催される。浦項国際不光祭りは、世界的な鉄鋼都市・浦項を象徴する産業の「光」と熱い溶鉱炉の「火」をテーマに、2004年の浦項市民の日を記念して開催された花火ショーから始まった。

その後、国際規模の祭りに成長し、世界各国の有名な花火チームが参加する国際花火ショーをはじめ、多様な見どころを披露している。近年では、単なる花火中心の祭りから脱却し、メディアファサード、夜間パレードなど産業と文化芸術を融合した多彩なコンテンツを拡大している。また、浦項の海洋景観と都市空間を活用し、市民と観光客が共に楽しむ参加型祭りに発展し、浦項の都市ブランドと夜間観光の競争力を高める代表的な文化観光祭りに定着している。

en.title: Maple Tree Forest Path Healing Festival
en.overview: The Independence Hall Maple Tree Forest Path is a representative autumn attraction in Cheonan, featuring a walking trail where thousands of maple trees form a tunnel along a 3.2km section. Held every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday from October 16 to November 15, the Independence Hall Maple Tree Forest Path Healing Festival is a cultural festival combining the natural scenery and history of the Independence Hall area in autumn. During the festival period, walking courses to enjoy nature centered around the brightly dyed maple tree forest path are opened.
en.pull_quote: Chungnam Cheonan-si Dongnam-gu Season Recommended Festival · Independence Hall Maple Tree Forest Path, Gyeoroeui-jib (2026.10.15 ~ 2026.11.15)
paragraphs: The Independence Hall Maple Tree Forest Path is a representative autumn attraction in Cheonan, featuring a walking trail where thousands of maple trees form a tunnel along a 3.2km section. Held every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday from October 16 to November 15, the Independence Hall Maple Tree Forest Path Healing Festival is a cultural festival combining the natural scenery and history of the Independence Hall area in autumn. During the festival period, walking courses to enjoy nature centered around the brightly dyed maple tree forest path are opened and various cultural events take place.

Night commentaries at the Museum of Japanese Government-General Relics Demolition provide historical lessons and the spirit of independence. Special night illumination lights celebrating the 150th anniversary of the birth of Baekbeom Kim Gu are installed, and a media facade combining the latest media art against the backdrop of the Gyeoroeui-tap (Tower of the Nation) offers specialized night sights for visitors. In addition to forest healing during the day, it provides a cultural space harmonizing night lighting, media art, and historical commentary. Combining rest in nature and historically symbolic spaces, this is a complex healing festival that all generations can enjoy together.

朝鮮総督府撤去部材展示公園の夜間解説を運営し、歴史的教訓と独立精神を伝えます。白凡・金九（キム・グ）誕生150周年を記念する特別な夜間景観照明を設置し、「キョレの塔」を背景に最新のメディアアートを融合させたメディアファサードを展示して、観覧客に見応えのある夜の見どころを提供します。昼間の森のヒーリングだけでなく、夜の照明やメディアアート、歴史解説が調和をなす文化空間を提供します。このように自然の中の休息と歴史的象徴空間が結合し、全世代が一緒に楽しめる複合ヒーリング祭りです。

en.title: Hunryeonwon Park
en.overview: This site was once the training ground for soldiers, where martial arts training and military formations were taught. Established in 1392 during the reign of King Taejo of Joseon, it was initially called the Training Hall. Later, during King Taejong's reign, it was moved here, and a large hall for archery practice and military examinations was built. It was renamed Hunryeonwon in 1466.
en.pull_quote: This site was once the training ground for soldiers, where martial arts training and military formations were taught.
paragraphs: This site was once the training ground for soldiers, where martial arts training and military formations were taught. Established in 1392 during the reign of King Taejo of Joseon, it was initially called the Training Hall. Later, during King Taejong's reign, it was moved here, and a large hall for archery practice and military examinations was built. It was renamed Hunryeonwon in 1466.

Before the current Hunryeonwon Park and parking lot were built, there was a wooden structure decorated with red bricks, made from timber transported from Baekdusan along the Amnok River to the Yellow Sea. The wood recovered during the demolition was processed to create this information board, preserving the historical essence. The park opened on June 30, 1997, featuring landscaped facilities such as lawns, drinking fountains, and mist fountains, along with management offices, restrooms, and benches.

en.title: Tapgol Park
en.overview: Tapgol Park is the first modern park in Seoul, built on the site of the Won-gak Temple during the Joseon Dynasty. Established in 1397, it was transformed into a park by British advisor Brown in 1897 and officially opened in 1920. It is historically significant as the site where the Declaration of Independence was first read during the March 1st Movement in 1919.
en.pull_quote: Tapgol Park is the first modern park in Seoul, built on the site of the Won-gak Temple during the Joseon Dynasty.
paragraphs: Tapgol Park is the first modern park in Seoul, built on the site of the Won-gak Temple during the Joseon Dynasty. Established in 1397, it was transformed into a park by British advisor Brown in 1897 and officially opened in 1920. It is historically significant as the site where the Declaration of Independence was first read during the March 1st Movement in 1919.

On May 28, 1992, the park's name was changed from Pagoda Park to Tapgol Park. The park features cultural heritage sites such as the National Treasure 10-story stone pagoda of Won-gak Temple, the 3·1 Movement Memorial Tower, murals commemorating the 3·1 Movement, and statues and memorials for independence activists.

ja.title: タプゴル公園
ja.addr: ソウル特別市 鍾路区 鍾路 99
ja.overview: タプゴル公園は、朝鮮時代の元覚寺跡に建てられたソウル初の近代的な公園です。1397年に元覚寺として設立され、1897年にイギリス人アドバイザーのブラウンによって公園に整備され、1920年に公園として開園しました。1919年の3・1運動の際に初めて独立宣言が読み上げられた場所であり、我々の民族の独立精神が息づく歴史的な場所です。
ja.pull_quote: タプゴル公園は、朝鮮時代の元覚寺跡に建てられたソウル初の近代的な公園です。
paragraphs: タプゴル公園は、朝鮮時代の元覚寺跡に建てられたソウル初の近代的な公園です。1397年に元覚寺として設立され、1897年にイギリス人アドバイザーのブラウンによって公園に整備され、1920年に公園として開園しました。1919年の3・1運動の際に初めて独立宣言が読み上げられた場所であり、我々の民族の独立精神が息づく歴史的な場所です。
1992年5月28日に公園名をパゴダ公園からタプゴル公園に改称し、現在に至っています。公園内には独立運動の火を灯した八角亭を中心に、国宝の元覚寺10層石塔、宝物の元覚寺碑などの文化遺産や、3・1運動記念塔、3・1運動壁画、義士ソン・ビョンヒの銅像、ハン・ヨンウンの記念碑などがあります。

zh.title: 塔谷公園

zh.overview: 塔谷公園是建立在朝鮮時代元覺寺遺址上的首爾第一座現代化公園。於1397年建立，1897年由英國顧問布朗改建為公園，並於1920年正式開放。它是1919年三一運動中首次宣讀獨立宣言的地方，是我們民族獨立精神的歷史見證。

en.title: Yongwangsan Neighborhood Park
en.overview: Yongwangsan was recorded as 'Eomji Mountain' on old maps, where 'Eomji' means 'the beginning' or 'the best' in pure Korean. It is located at the entrance of a field where Cheonho could live. According to a legend, it was renamed Yongwangsan, 'Mountain of the Dragon King', after a person with the surname Park died and failed to be reborn as a king. The mountain is also called 'Yeoksan' because it turns its back on Hanyang.

The mountain is also called 'Yeoksan' because it turns its back on Hanyang. Every year on January 1st, a New Year's sunrise festival is held at Yongwangsan Neighborhood Park, starting with events like 'Writing New Year Wishes' and 'Traditional Performances', culminating in a drum performance to wish for harmony and local development.

ja.overview: 龍王山は古い地図には「ウムジ山」と記載されており、ウムジは純粋な韓国語で「最初」または「最高」という意味です。天湖が住むことができる野原の入口に位置しているため、この名前が付けられました。龍王山の別名は、パク姓の人が死んで王に生まれ変わろうとした伝説に基づいて「龍王山」、「王霊山」、「王財山」と呼ばれるようになりました。伝説の時期を推定すると、600年前の地図にはウムジ山と記載されていることから、朝鮮時代のものであると考えられます。
ja.pull_quote: 龍王山は古い地図には「ウムジ山」と記載されており、ウムジは純粋な韓国語で「最初」または「最高」という意味です。

en.title: Ok Doenjang Magok Branch
en.overview: Ok Doenjang Magok Branch specializes in doenjang jeongol (soybean paste stew) and beef sujok jeongol. It showcases dishes primarily made with doenjang, a representative fermented paste of Korea, and operates over 90 locations nationwide. The name 'Ok' signifies the taste of homemade doenjang that families used to enjoy at home.
en.pull_quote: Signature Dishes: Beef Belly Doenjang Jeongol · Snail Doenjang Jeongol / Squid Doenjang Jeongol / Squid Minari Jeon, etc.
paragraphs: Ok Doenjang Magok Branch specializes in doenjang jeongol (soybean paste stew) and beef sujok jeongol. It showcases dishes primarily made with doenjang, a representative fermented paste of Korea, and operates over 90 locations nationwide. The name 'Ok' signifies the taste of homemade doenjang that families used to enjoy at home.

The signature dish, doenjang jeongol, is a pot dish made by boiling beef belly, snails, shiitake mushrooms, and clams in a broth with dissolved doenjang, cooked directly on the induction stove at the table. All dishes feature minari (Korean water parsley). Beef sujok jeongol, sundubu jeongol, minari jeon, and boiled beef dishes are also served. Located on the first floor of the Magok Science Tower in Gangseo-gu, Seoul.

en.title: Bolt Steakhouse
en.overview: Bolt Steakhouse, recognized by the steak capital of the USA, offers USDA PRIME BEEF STEAK from the top 3% of beef. It has been selected annually in the Michelin Guide Seoul from 2017 to 2025. The secret lies in using the same dry aging equipment and techniques as the renowned Peter Luger Steak House and Wolfgang's Steakhouse in New York, along with the same quality of meat. Bolt Steakhouse uses only USDA PRIME BEEF certified by the US Department of Agriculture.
en.pull_quote: Signature Dishes: Porterhouse · T-bone / Elbon / Bone-in Ribeye / Tenderloin / New York Strip / Ribeye, etc.
paragraphs: Bolt Steakhouse, recognized by the steak capital of the USA, offers USDA PRIME BEEF STEAK from the top 3% of beef. It has been selected annually in the Michelin Guide Seoul from 2017 to 2025. The secret lies in using the same dry aging equipment and techniques as the renowned Peter Luger Steak House and Wolfgang's Steakhouse in New York, along with the same quality of meat.

Bolt Steakhouse uses only USDA PRIME BEEF certified by the US Department of Agriculture. The meat is hand-selected from the top 3% of prime beef and is dry-aged for 4-5 weeks in-house, enhancing its rich flavor. The dry aging process preserves the meat's natural juices and texture while intensifying its deep and rich taste and aroma. This meat is aged and cooked by skilled chefs who have trained at renowned steakhouses in New York.

ja.title: ボルトステーキハウス
ja.addr: ソウル特別市 江南区 アプクジョン路72キル 22
ja.overview: ボルトステーキハウスは、ステーキの本場アメリカが認めた、上位3%の最高級USDAプライムビーフステーキを味わえる場所です。2017年から2025年まで毎年ミシュランガイドソウルに選ばれています。その秘密は、アメリカのニューヨークにあるピータールーガーステーキハウスやウルフギャングステーキハウスと同じドライエイジング設備と技術を使用し、同じ品質の肉を使っていることです。ボルトステーキハウスは、アメリカ農務省が認証したプライム肉（USDAプライムビーフ）を厳選して使用しています。
ja.pull_quote: 代表料理: ポーターハウス · ティボーン / エルボン / 骨付きリブアイ / テンダーロイン / ニューヨークストリップ / リブアイなど
paragraphs: ボルトステーキハウスは、ステーキの本場アメリカが認めた、上位3%の最高級USDAプライムビーフステーキを味わえる場所です。2017年から2025年まで毎年ミシュランガイドソウルに選ばれています。その秘密は、アメリカのニューヨークにあるピータールーガーステーキハウスやウルフギャングステーキハウスと同じドライエイジング設備と技術を使用し、同じ品質の肉を使っていることです。

ボルトステーキハウスは、アメリカ農務省が認証したプライム肉（USDAプライムビーフ）を厳選して使用しています。肉はハウスの一角に設置されたドライエイジング施設で4〜5週間のドライエイジングを経て、さらに豊かな風味を持つようになります。ドライエイジングの過程で肉本来の肉汁と食感はそのまま保たれ、深く豊かな味と香りが増します。この肉は、ピータールーガーやウルフギャングなど、ニューヨークのステーキハウスでの経験を持つ熟練シェフの手で熟成され、調理されます。

zh.pull_quote: 招牌美食: 波特豪斯 · T骨 / 肋眼 / 牛里脊 / 纽约条 / 肋眼等
paragraphs: 博尔特牛排馆是美国认可的牛排之乡，提供来自前3% USDA PRIME BEEF STEAK的美味。该餐厅自2017年至2025年每年被选入米其林指南。其秘诀在于使用与纽约著名的彼得·卢格牛排馆和沃尔夫冈牛排馆相同的干式熟成设备和技术，以及相同质量的肉。
博尔特牛排馆使用美国农业部认证的优质肉（USDA PRIME BEEF）。肉类经过手工挑选，来自前3%优质肉，经过4-5周的干式熟成，增强其丰富的风味。干式熟成过程中，肉类的天然汁液和质地得以保留，同时其深厚而丰富的味道和香气得以增强。这些肉类由在纽约著名牛排馆工作的经验丰富的厨师进行熟成和烹饪。

en.title: Pyeongchang Trout Festival
en.overview: * The following information is based on the 2026 festival, and details for 2027 are currently being updated. In the past, heavy winter snows forced villagers to tie ropes to neighbors' homes to create snow tunnels just to visit each other. During those difficult times when icy river winds froze the streams early, people would strike large riverbed rocks with hammers to catch winter fish for a single meal. Transforming our ancestors' hardships into a celebration, the Pyeongchang Trout Festival is held every year from late December to late January under the theme of a winter tale featuring snow, ice, and trout.
en.pull_quote: Recommended Seasonal Festival in Jinbu-myeon, Pyeongchang-gun, Gangwon-do · Pyeongchang Trout Festival Venue (2027.01.01 ~ 2027.01.31)

Transforming our ancestors' hardships into a celebration, the Pyeongchang Trout Festival is held every year from late December to late January under the theme of a winter tale featuring snow, ice, and trout.

Through the transparent ice, visitors can see fish swimming gracefully in the Odaecheon Stream. Experience the thrilling catch of trout fishing along with various winter activities for the ultimate winter festival enjoyment.

en.title: Christmas Village Busan 2026
en.overview: From November 26 to December 25, 'Christmas Village Busan 2026', a Christmas village that appears in Busan once a year, will be held at the Busan Cinema Center. Building on last year's success with 450,000 visitors, this year's festival returns as an immersive Christmas theme park where visitors can walk, see, taste, and experience. Enjoy snowy plazas, parades, choir performances, and more.
en.pull_quote: Haeundae-gu, Busan Seasonal Recommended Festival · Busan Cinema Center (2026.11.26 ~ 2026.12.25)
paragraphs: From November 26 to December 25, 'Christmas Village Busan 2026', a Christmas village that appears in Busan once a year, will be held at the Busan Cinema Center. Building on last year's success with 450,000 visitors, this year's festival returns as an immersive Christmas theme park where visitors can walk, see, taste, and experience.

In this living village welcomed by villagers such as Santa, a postman, and a mountain lodge owner, visitors can enjoy snowy plazas, parades, choir performances, Christmas-exclusive menus created by Chef Kang Leo and local Busan brands, gift shops, and seasonal pop-ups. paragraphs: The 2026 Ginkgo Tree Road Street Art Festival is a citizen-participatory street art festival held around the Ginkgo Tree Road, a representative autumn attraction in Asan-si. en.title: Ulsan Culture Expo
en.overview: Under the slogan "My Ulsan, Our City," the 2026 Ulsan Culture Expo is a comprehensive cultural festival where the daily lives and stories of individual citizens come together to form the city's culture. Following the inscription of the Petroglyphs of Bangucheon Stream on the UNESCO World Heritage list in July 2025, Ulsan is gaining attention as a city where a long history and modern culture coexist.
en.pull_quote: Samnam-eup, Ulju-gun, Ulsan Seasonal Recommended Festival · UECO (2026.11.26 ~ 2026.11.29)
paragraphs: Under the slogan "My Ulsan, Our City," the 2026 Ulsan Culture Expo is a comprehensive cultural festival where the daily lives and stories of individual citizens come together to form the city's culture. Following the inscription of the Petroglyphs of Bangucheon Stream on the UNESCO World Heritage list in July 2025, Ulsan is gaining attention as a city where a long history and modern culture coexist. Just as prehistoric people carved their lives into rocks, today's citizens of Ulsan are carving the city's culture in their own ways from their respective places. This year's expo focuses on the flow where individual cultures starting from "My Ulsan" lead to the shared asset of "Our City."

The core value of this expo is "Cultural Governance Growing Together." Citizens, local artists, cultural enterprises, universities, and public institutions participate together from planning to operation, creating a venue for culture built by everyone rather than a unilateral exhibition. Additionally, exchange programs with culture city officials nationwide will share Ulsan's cultural city experience and expand regional cooperation. 2026 Ulsan Culture Expo

ja.pull_quote: 蔚山蔚州郡三南邑 季節のおすすめ祭り · UECO（ユエコ）（2026.11.26 ~ 2026.11.29）
paragraphs: 2026蔚山文化博覧会は「私の蔚山、私たちの都市」をスローガンに、市民一人ひとりの日常と物語が集まって都市の文化になる過程を共に分かち合う総合文化祭である。2025年7月に「盤구川の岩絵」がユネスコ世界遺産に登録され、蔚山は長い歴史と現代文化が共存する都市として注目を集めている。先史時代の人々が岩に自分たちの生活を刻んだように、今日の蔚山の人々もそれぞれの場所でそれぞれの方法で都市の文化を刻んでいる。今年の博覧会は、「私の蔚山」から出発した個々人の文化が「私たちの都市」という共通の資産へとつながる流れに注目する。
今回の博覧会の核心価値は「共に成長する文化ガバナンス」である。市民と地域の文化芸術人、文化企業、大学、公共機関が企画から運営まで共に参加し、一方的に見せる展示を越えて誰もが共に作っていく文化の場を繰り広げる。あわせて全国の文化都市関係者たちとの交流プログラムを通じて、蔚山の文化都市の経験を分かち合い、地域間の協力の幅を広げていく。2026蔚山문화박람회

paragraphs: 2026蔚山文化博覽會以「我的蔚山，我們的城市」為口號，是一場匯聚市民們的日常生活與故事、共同分享城市文化誕生過程的綜合文化慶典。隨著2025年7月「盤龜川的岩刻畫」被登錄為聯合國教科文組織世界遺產，蔚山作為一座歷史悠久與現代文化共存的城市備受矚目。正如史前人類在岩石上刻下生活痕跡一般，如今的蔚山市民也正在各自的崗位上，以獨特的方式刻劃著城市的文化。本屆博覽會聚焦於從「我的蔚山」出發的個人文化，如何延續為「我們城市」這一共同資產的脈絡。

en.title: Haeundae Light Festival
en.overview: Haeundae-gu (Mayor Kim Sung-soo) will hold the 13th Haeundae Light Festival starting with a lighting ceremony on November 28 until January 10 of next year. This year's festival theme is 'Deep Dive Haeundae,' showcasing a journey of light that grows brighter the deeper you descend from the surface into the deep sea.
en.pull_quote: Jung-dong, Haeundae-gu, Busan Seasonal Recommended Festival · Gunam-ro & Haeundae Beach area (2026.11.28 ~ 2027.01.10)
paragraphs: Haeundae-gu (Mayor Kim Sung-soo) will hold the 13th Haeundae Light Festival starting with a lighting ceremony on November 28 until January 10 of next year. This year's festival theme is 'Deep Dive Haeundae,' showcasing a journey of light that grows brighter the deeper you descend from the surface into the deep sea. Colorful light sculptures and media art themed around the ocean, navigation, and the deep sea will be installed across the area connecting Haeundae Square (Gunam-ro) and the sandy beach, offering visitors an immersive experience as if exploring underwater. During the festival, Haeundae Square will be decorated as a dynamic sailing space heading toward the deep sea.

The 'Cruise Gate,' announcing the departure of a cruise, and a 30-meter-long light tunnel greet visitors. Wave-themed photo zones and light sculptures reminiscent of a cruise shipboard party follow, while LED panels installed on a large diver sculpture will display ocean exploration media art to catch the eye. The Christmas tree illuminating Haeundae Square will also be specially decorated with a total of 11 trees, including a maximum height of 6 meters.

en.pull_quote: Seoul Jung-gu Recommended Seasonal Festival · Cheonggyecheon Cheonggye Plaza Area, Jung-gu, Seoul (2026.12.11 ~ 2026.12.31)
paragraphs: First lighting up Seoul's winter night in 2015, 'Cheonggyecheon Light' will be held for 21 days from December 11 to 31 at Seoul Cheonggye Plaza, marking its 12th winter.

This year, under the theme 'Light Up Tomorrow,' it is newly presented as a storytelling festival that tells the dreams and hopes of citizens through light. In addition to the much-loved unique trees, photo zones, and dream train (mini train) rides, this year features large LED screens displaying dream drawings created by children with developmental disabilities and dream messages sent by citizens. The festival illuminates Cheonggye Plaza every day from 6 PM to 10 PM, and anyone can view it for free.

en.title: Ulsan Christmas Market
en.overview: The Ulsan Christmas Market is a Christmas-themed night market held around the windmill at the main gate of Ulsan Grand Park from November 27 to December 26, 2026. Hosted and organized by the Ulsan Culture and Tourism Foundation, the event features sales, hands-on experiences, food, amusement facilities, and performance programs.
en.pull_quote: Nam-gu, Ulsan Seasonal Recommended Festival · Ulsan Grand Park Windmill Area (2026.11.27 ~ 2026.12.26)
paragraphs: The Ulsan Christmas Market is a Christmas-themed night market held around the windmill at the main gate of Ulsan Grand Park from November 27 to December 26, 2026. Hosted and organized by the Ulsan Culture and Tourism Foundation, the event features sales, hands-on experiences, food, amusement facilities, and performance programs. Regular operation days are every Friday and Saturday during the event period, from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Operating days are extended during Christmas week, running for a total of four days from Wednesday, December 23 to Saturday, December 26.

Key highlights include sales booths offering various products, visitor participation experience booths, food booths, and food trucks. Additionally, a carousel, Santa's House, and a snow zone will be operated alongside busking performances. Main activities within the venue include shopping, experiences, dining, amusement rides, and watching performances. The venue is located around the windmill at the main gate of Ulsan Grand Park and its surrounding area.

en.title: Learn and Understand History
en.overview: "Learn and Understand History" is a participatory history and culture program where families can explore and experience Jeonju's historical and cultural heritage, based on "Wanyengillok"—a record of work and daily life at Jeollagamyeong by Joseon-dynasty Jeolla Governor Seo Yu-gu. Visitors can explore major historical and cultural spaces including Jeollagamyeong, Honam Regional Yedamgo, Wanpanbon Culture Center, Jeondong Catholic Church, and Pungnammun Gate with professional commentary, while experiencing diverse aspects of Jeonju's history and culture through artifact viewing and excavation experiences, woodblock printing, and pansori (traditional narrative chant) performances.

and experience Jeonju's history and culture richly through artifact viewing and excavation experiences, woodblock printing, and pansori performance viewing. paragraphs: The Jinan Plateau Kimchi & Bossam Festival is a local festival held in Jinan-gun, Jeonbuk State, designed to combine Korea's unique traditional culture of Kimjang with festivals to spread a community culture where families and neighbors come together. In a dietary environment that is gradually changing due to the nuclear family trend and the increase of single-person households, its purpose is to reflect on the traditional value of Kimjang culture and share affection among neighbors through the process of making and sharing kimchi together.

Various experience and participation events are operated, including Kimjang experiences utilizing local agricultural products produced in the clean natural environment of the Jinan Plateau, and kimchi and bossam food programs. It is a festival where you can experience the succession of traditional Kimjang culture and the value of local agricultural products together.

ja.overview: 光復路ファッション通りは、かつて川だった場所を埋め立てて道路として利用しているエリアで、両側には古くから衣料品店が集まっています。農協釜山支店から国際市場の飲食街の入口までが光復路ファッション通りで、ここは韓国の衣料品や靴が集まる場所で、夜間や週末には多くの人々が訪れます。
ja.pull_quote: 光復路ファッション通りは、かつて川だった場所を埋め立てて道路として利用しているエリアです。
paragraphs: 光復路ファッション通りは、かつて川だった場所を埋め立てて道路として利用しているエリアで、両側には古くから衣料品店が集まっています。農協釜山支店から国際市場の飲食街の入口までが光復路ファッション通りで、ここは韓国の衣料品や靴が集まる場所で、夜間や週末には多くの人々が訪れます。
毎年12月には中区庁が光復路冬のライトツリー祭りを開催しており、さまざまな種類の照明や模型が飾られ、美しい通りに変身します。祭りの期間中は光復路周辺が車の通行ができない通りとなり、ゆっくりと祭りを楽しむことができます。光復路文化ファッション通りには文化、ファッション、グルメが並んでおり、訪れると若さと活気を感じることができます。

zh.title: 光复路时尚街
zh.addr: 釜山广域市中区光复路72-1 (光复洞2街)
zh.overview: 光复路时尚街是一个充满活力的区域，沿街两侧聚集了许多服装店，这里曾是一条河流。光复路时尚街从农协釜山分行延伸到国际市场的美食街入口，是韩国服装和鞋类的集中地，尤其在周末和晚上吸引了大量游客。
zh.pull_quote: 光复路时尚街是一个充满活力的区域，沿街两侧聚集了许多服装店。

每年12月，中区政府会举办光复路冬季灯光树节，街道装饰着各种灯光和模型，变成一条美丽的街道。在节日期间，光复路周边会变成无车街道，游客可以悠闲地享受节日。光复路文化时尚街则是文化、时尚和美食的聚集地，给人一种年轻和活力的感觉。

en.title: Peace Park
en.overview: Peace Park is located in Daeyeon-dong, Busan, and is known as a representative resting place for Busan citizens. Established near the UN Memorial Park to commemorate the 2005 APEC Summit, it features various facilities such as a floor fountain, pergola, and jogging course. The park is surrounded by museums and cultural centers, making it a historical and cultural experience.
en.pull_quote: Peace Park is located in Daeyeon-dong, Busan, and is known as a representative resting place for Busan citizens.
paragraphs: Peace Park is located in Daeyeon-dong, Busan, and is known as a representative resting place for Busan citizens. Established near the UN Memorial Park to commemorate the 2005 APEC Summit, it features various facilities such as a floor fountain, pergola, and jogging course.

Additionally, it is a scenic spot that harmonizes with nearby museums and cultural centers. The park has planted 30,000 trees, including camellias and pines, creating a lush green space. In the center of the park, there is a fountain that shoots up into the sky, perfect for summer water play, and at night, it provides a beautiful backdrop for couples.

en.title: Hwangnyeongsan Mountain
en.overview: Hwangnyeongsan Mountain (荒嶺山) envelops the city of Busan with its lush green forests. It offers a refreshing escape for hikers and a stunning view of the city lights for night-time visitors. At 427 meters above sea level, it is the second-highest mountain in the Geumryeonsan range, marking the boundary between Busanjin-gu, Nam-gu, and Suyeong-gu.
en.pull_quote: Hwangnyeongsan Mountain (荒嶺山) envelops the city of Busan with its lush green forests.
paragraphs: Hwangnyeongsan Mountain (荒嶺山) envelops the city of Busan with its lush green forests. It offers a refreshing escape for hikers and a stunning view of the city lights for night-time visitors. At 427 meters above sea level, it is the second-highest mountain in the Geumryeonsan range, marking the boundary between Busanjin-gu, Nam-gu, and Suyeong-gu. The trail is not very long, making it possible to hike in about 2-3 hours.

The eastern side of the mountain is popular among local residents for early morning hikes and has become a favored dating spot for couples. The northwestern foothills connect to Yangjeong-dong, while Jeonpo-dong lies in the center. Facilities for relaxation and youth training are available at the foot of the mountain. Hikers can access Hwangnyeongsan and Geumryeonsan from various points including Mangmi, Yeonsan, Yangjeong, and Jeonpo, with route selection based on convenience.

ja.title: 荒嶺山
ja.addr: 釜山広域市南区荒嶺山路391-39
ja.overview: 荒嶺山（Hwangnyeongsan）は釜山の中心部を囲むように広がり、緑豊かな森を提供しています。ハイカーには森と風と空を楽しませ、夜景を楽しむ観光客には素晴らしい光の世界を提供する場所です。また、釜山の典型的な都市の山で、釜山鎮区、南区、水営区の境界を成す山であり、標高427mで金蓮山脈の中で二番目に高い山です。
ja.pull_quote: 荒嶺山（Hwangnyeongsan）は釜山の中心部を囲むように広がり、緑豊かな森を提供しています。
paragraphs: 荒嶺山（Hwangnyeongsan）は釜山の中心部を囲むように広がり、緑豊かな森を提供しています。ハイカーには森と風と空を楽しませ、夜景を楽しむ観光客には素晴らしい光の世界を提供する場所です。また、釜山の典型的な都市の山で、釜山鎮区、南区、水営区の境界を成す山であり、標高427mで金蓮山脈の中で二番目に高い山です。山の道はそれほど広くないため、2〜3時間で登ることができます。
近隣住民の早朝ハイキングスポットとして、アベックのデートコースとしても人気のある東側は南区に接し、西側は釜山鎮区に接しています。北西側の山麓には楊井洞、中央には全浦洞があります。この山麓には釜山市民の憩いの場や若者の修練場が開設されています。荒嶺山と金蓮山は望美、連山、楊井、全浦、大連洞などから登ることができます。コース選択は交通手段を考慮して便利な場所で決めると良いでしょう。

zh.addr: 釜山广域市南区荒岭山路391-39
zh.overview: 荒岭山（Hwangnyeongsan）环绕着釜山市中心，提供郁郁葱葱的森林。它为登山者提供了森林、微风和天空的享受，同时为夜景爱好者提供了迷人的光影世界。作为釜山典型的城市山脉，荒岭山与釜山镇区、南区和水营区相接，海拔427米，是金莲山脉中第二高的山。

en.title: Dongbaek Park
en.overview: Dongbaek Park is located on Dongbaek Island at the southern end of Haeundae Beach. Designated as a park in September 1966, it was developed in the 1990s and features beautiful natural scenery with camellias and pines. Following the 2006 APEC event in Busan, the park underwent renovations, including landscaping, installation of observation decks, coastal maintenance, and the creation of rest areas and parking.
en.pull_quote: Dongbaek Park is located on Dongbaek Island at the southern end of Haeundae Beach.
paragraphs: Dongbaek Park is located on Dongbaek Island at the southern end of Haeundae Beach. Designated as a park in September 1966, it was developed in the 1990s and features beautiful natural scenery with camellias and pines. Following the 2006 APEC event in Busan, the park underwent renovations, including landscaping, installation of observation decks, coastal maintenance, and the creation of rest areas and parking.

In addition to walking paths, the park offers facilities such as badminton courts, benches, and restrooms. Key attractions include the Choi Chi-won Historic Site, Nurimaru APEC House, Haeundae Stone Carvings, and the mermaid statue on Dongbaek Island, which is tied to a legend about Princess Hwang-ok marrying the king of the Mugu kingdom. The coastal walking path around Dongbaek Island is perfect for leisurely strolls or exercise.

ja.title: 冬柏公園

ja.overview: 冬柏公園は海雲台海水浴場の南端にある冬柏島を公園として整備したもので、1966年9月に公園用地として指定され、1990年代に本格的に開発されました。冬柏の木や松の木が生い茂る美しい自然景観が広がる場所で、陸地とつながった陸系島です。2006年に釜山でAPECが開催された際、冬柏公園は整備され、景観復元、展望デッキの設置、海岸の整備、山頂広場や循環道路の整備、休憩広場や駐車場などが新たに整備され、観光客の訪問が絶えない場所となっています。

en.title: Old Baekje Hospital, Busan
en.overview: The Old Baekje Hospital is the first modern private general hospital building in Busan, serving as an important medical institution alongside Busan Municipal Hospital and Railway Hospital. According to the National Heritage Portal, the building was formed by combining two structures built in February and December 1927. After the hospital closed, it was used for various purposes, including a Chinese restaurant, Japanese military officer's quarters, Busan Police Headquarters, the Republic of China’s temporary embassy, and a wedding hall. After a fire in 1972, the fifth floor was demolished, and it currently stands as a four-story building.
en.pull_quote: Local Recommended Partner · Nearby Restaurants & Safe Accommodation Routes
paragraphs: The Old Baekje Hospital is the first modern private general hospital building in Busan, serving as an important medical institution alongside Busan Municipal Hospital and Railway Hospital. According to the National Heritage Portal, the building was formed by combining two structures built in February and December 1927.

After the hospital closed, it was used for various purposes, including a Chinese restaurant, Japanese military officer's quarters, Busan Police Headquarters, the Republic of China’s temporary embassy, and a wedding hall. After a fire in 1972, the fifth floor was demolished, and it currently stands as a four-story building. The building features various indoor spaces in square and diamond shapes, with wooden stairs and decorations that are relatively well-preserved, allowing visitors to explore modern hospital architecture and medical history.

ja.title: 釜山旧百済病院

ja.overview: 釜山旧百済病院は、釜山初の近代式個人総合病院の建物で、釜山市立病院・鉄道病院と共に地域の重要な医療機関として使用されていました。国家遺産ポータルによると、1927年2月と12月にそれぞれ建設された2つの建物が合体したものです。病院閉院後は、中国料理店、日本軍将校宿舎、釜山治安司令部、中華民国臨時大使館、結婚式場など、さまざまな用途で使用されました。1972年の火災後、5階部分が取り壊され、現在は4階建ての建物として残っています。

病院閉院後は、中国料理店、日本軍将校宿舎、釜山治安司令部、中華民国臨時大使館、結婚式場など、さまざまな用途で使用されました。1972年の火災後、5階部分が取り壊され、現在は4階建ての建物として残っています。建物には、四角形やひし形などのさまざまな形の室内空間、木製の階段や装飾があり、比較的良く保存されており、近代病院建築と医療史を探ることができます。

zh.overview: 釜山旧百济医院是釜山首个现代化私人综合医院建筑，曾与釜山市立医院和铁路医院一起成为该地区重要的医疗机构。根据国家遗产门户网站的信息，该建筑由1927年2月和12月分别建造的两栋建筑合并而成。医院关闭后，曾用作中餐馆、日本军官宿舍、釜山治安司令部、中华民国临时大使馆和婚礼场所等多种用途。1972年火灾后，五层部分被拆除，目前保留为四层建筑。

en.title: Geumjeongsan Mountain
en.overview: Geumjeongsan National Geopark is a mountain formed by granite that solidified from magma underground about 70 million years ago, serving as the root of Busan's land. Visitors can admire the elegant granite formations shaped by years of wind and rain, including cliffs, tors, inselbergs, and block streams. The main peak, Godangbong, along with Janggunbong, Wonhyo-bong, and Sanghakbong, has fortresses built along the ridges connecting these peaks.
en.pull_quote: Local Recommended Partner · Nearby Restaurants & Safe Accommodation Routes
paragraphs: Geumjeongsan National Geopark is a mountain formed by granite that solidified from magma underground about 70 million years ago, serving as the root of Busan's land. Visitors can admire the elegant granite formations shaped by years of wind and rain, including cliffs, tors, inselbergs, and block streams. The main peak, Godangbong, along with Janggunbong, Wonhyo-bong, and Sanghakbong, has fortresses built along the ridges connecting these peaks.

These peaks and ridges feature unique tors, which are exposed remnants of large and small bedrock from the Cretaceous Bulguksa granite. The geology of Geumjeongsan consists of sedimentary rock layers from the Gyeongsang Group and volcanic rocks that intruded or erupted through them, along with the Bulguksa granite and Masan granite that intruded into these rocks. Registered as a national geopark, Geumjeongsan boasts beautiful scenery where bizarre rock formations and nature harmoniously coexist.

ja.overview: 金井山国立ジオパークは、約7000万年前に地下でマグマが冷えて生成された花崗岩が隆起して形成された釜山の根源となる山です。長い年月、風雨に削られ、作られた奇岩絶壁、トール、インセルベルク、ブロックストリームなどの優雅な花崗岩地形を楽しむことができます。金井山の主峰である高堂峰をはじめ、将軍峰、元曉峰、上鶴峰などの山頂とこれらの山頂の間に続く山稜には、ほとんどが山城が築かれています。

paragraphs: 金井山国立ジオパークは、約7000万年前に地下でマグマが冷えて生成された花崗岩が隆起して形成された釜山の根源となる山です。長い年月、風雨に削られ、作られた奇岩絶壁、トール、インセルベルク、ブロックストリームなどの優雅な花崗岩地形を楽しむことができます。金井山の主峰である高堂峰をはじめ、将軍峰、元曉峰、上鶴峰などの山頂とこれらの山頂の間に続く山稜には、ほとんどが山城が築かれています。

en.title: Daecheon Stream
en.overview: Daecheon Stream originates from a valley between Parisbong and Daeryukbong of Geumjeongsan, flowing down to the west gate of Geumjeongsanseong Fortress, passing Hwamyeong Sports Park, and eventually joining the Nakdong River. In the middle of Daecheon Stream, there is a large waterhole called Aegiso (沼) formed by a 4m waterfall. Daecheon Stream is well-known as an urban leisure area, featuring the west gate of Geumjeongsan, Hwamyeong Arboretum, Geumjeongsan Trail, Aegiso Waterfall, beautiful valleys, and lush forests, making it a popular spot for summer tourists and Busan citizens.

ja.overview: ビスル山自然休養林は美しい自然景観と奇岩が豊富なビスル山内に位置するリラクゼーションスポットです。森林庁が発表した全国100大名山の一つであり、調和峰を中心に天王峰の冠木峰を左右に抱えるビスル山の休養林です。山の中腹まで主に針葉樹が茂っており、上部の稜線までには奇岩と紅葉が絶景を成しています。春には桜、夏には霧と渓谷キャンプ、秋には紅葉とススキ、冬には氷の景観が美しいです。
ja.pull_quote: ビスル山自然休養林は美しい自然景観と奇岩が豊富なビスル山内に位置するリラクゼーションスポットです...
paragraphs: ビスル山自然休養林は美しい自然景観と奇岩が豊富なビスル山内に位置するリラクゼーションスポットです。森林庁が発表した全国100大名山の一つであり、調和峰を中心に天王峰の冠木峰を左右に抱えるビスル山の休養林です。山の中腹まで主に針葉樹が茂っており、上部の稜線までには奇岩と紅葉が絶景を成しています。
春には桜、夏には霧と渓谷キャンプ、秋には紅葉とススキ、冬には氷の景観が美しいです。これによりビスル山自然休養林は四季を通じて自然の贈り物と共に休息できる場所です。休養林には森の家やオートキャンプ場、野外公演場、池、青少年訓練場、体力トレーニング場、芝生広場、写真撮影スポット、水遊び場、森林療法センターなどの体験施設や楽しみがあります。

en.title: Palgong Sunset
en.overview: Palgong Sunset Grill offers a delightful dining experience with a view of the beautiful nature of Palgong Mountain. It serves a variety of dishes, including Jirisan black pork skirt and pork belly, and native chicken, with the flavor of wood-fired grilled meat being exceptional. You can watch the food being cooked on a large iron plate right in front of you, and enjoy a spectacular fire show alongside the sunset over Palgong Mountain.
en.pull_quote: Signature Delicacies: Pork Belly · Whole Duck / Jirisan Black Pork Neck / Jirisan Black Pork Skirt, etc.
paragraphs: Palgong Sunset Grill offers a delightful dining experience with a view of the beautiful nature of Palgong Mountain. It serves a variety of dishes, including Jirisan black pork skirt and pork belly, and native chicken, with the flavor of wood-fired grilled meat being exceptional. You can watch the food being cooked on a large iron plate right in front of you, and enjoy a spectacular fire show alongside the sunset over Palgong Mountain.

The fire show uses high-quality imported liquor at 75 degrees to eliminate any gamey taste and enhance the clean and light flavor of the meat. The interior has seating for groups, making it suitable for various gatherings, and it features a large dedicated parking area for convenience. Being close to Palgong Mountain allows for enjoyable nature exploration before or after your meal.

ja.pull_quote: 代表的な美味しさ: サムギョプサル · 鴨一羽 / 智異山黒豚の肩ロース / 智異山黒豚のガルメギサルなど
paragraphs: パルゴンノウル鉄板焼きは、パルゴン山の美しい自然景観を楽しみながら鉄板焼きを楽しめる美味しい店です。智異山の黒豚のガルメギサルや豚バラ、在来鶏など多様なメニューを提供しており、特に薪で焼いた肉の風味が絶品です。大きな鉄板の上で料理が目の前で調理される様子を楽しむことができ、パルゴン山の夕日と共に華やかな炎のショーを楽しむ特別な楽しみもあります。

en.title: Old Dongchon Station, Daegu
en.overview: Located in Dong-gu, Old Dongchon Station began operations as a regular station in 1917 and was in service until 2008. It is the best-preserved station among the old Daegu Line stations and has retained much of its original 1930s architecture, earning it a designation as a registered cultural heritage site. The station features a wooden structure with a unique 'ㅅ'-shaped ceiling in the waiting room, and the design of the large gable of the waiting room and the small gable of the office is distinctive, allowing for clear visibility of the platform.
en.pull_quote: Local recommended partner · Nearby restaurants and safe accommodations
paragraphs: Located in Dong-gu, Old Dongchon Station began operations as a regular station in 1917 and was in service until 2008. It is the best-preserved station among the old Daegu Line stations and has retained much of its original 1930s architecture, earning it a designation as a registered cultural heritage site. The station features a wooden structure with a unique 'ㅅ'-shaped ceiling in the waiting room, and the design of the large gable of the waiting room and the small gable of the office is distinctive, allowing for clear visibility of the platform. Old Dongchon Station is architecturally significant due to its sharp gable roof design.

On May 15, 2008, the old Daegu Line was officially closed, and Old Dongchon Station was shut down along with Banya-wol Station. On April 1, 2014, Dongchon Park was established on the site of the old Daegu Line, and Old Dongchon Station was relocated and restored from Geomsa-dong in Dong-gu. Since May 17, 2014, it has been utilized as the 'Dongchon Station Small Library'. The park preserves part of the old railway tracks that were at Dongchon Station and has created an exhibition space within the Old Dongchon Station building.

en.title: 2·28 Memorial Central Park
en.overview: 2·28 Memorial Central Park was established to commemorate the 2·28 Student Democratic Movement. Opened in June 2003, it covers an area of 14,354㎡. The 2·28 Student Democratic Movement, which occurred in 1960, was a student-led protest in Daegu against the corrupt Rhee Syng-man regime, serving as a catalyst for the 3·15 Masan Incident and the 4·19 Revolution that ultimately led to the fall of the Rhee government. The park is located on the site of the former Daegu Central Elementary School, where traces of the 2·28 movement remain.

The park is located on the site of the former Daegu Central Elementary School, where traces of the 2·28 movement remain.

The park features a central fountain that emits water from a semi-circular sculpture, along with three illuminated fountains, walking paths, an artificial stream, over 90 benches, and poetry stones by poet Kim Yun-sik. Most notably, it provides a pleasant green space in the city with over 1,000 trees of 28 species, 20 species of shrubs, and 30,000 flowering plants, along with grass.

en.title: Daegu Citizen Safety Theme Park
en.overview: Daegu Citizen Safety Theme Park was established to promote citizen safety education and culture through dynamic experiential learning. It features specialized safety experience zones, including a subway safety experience area, earthquake safety zone, future safety video hall (4D), traffic safety experience area, and a children's product safety experience center, allowing visitors to realistically experience disaster situations they may encounter in daily life.
en.pull_quote: Daegu Citizen Safety Theme Park was established to promote citizen safety education and culture through dynamic experiential learning…
paragraphs: Daegu Citizen Safety Theme Park was established to promote citizen safety education and culture through dynamic experiential learning. It features specialized safety experience zones, including a subway safety experience area, earthquake safety zone, future safety video hall (4D), traffic safety experience area, and a children's product safety experience center, allowing visitors to realistically experience disaster situations they may encounter in daily life.

Notably, the traffic safety experience area, which opened in October 2020, allows children to ride mini cars and experience various traffic safety scenarios, making it very popular among young visitors. The second hall features crisis response experience areas for fire suppression, smoke and escape device training, and a monorail experience that replicates the Daegu Metro Line 3. The CPR training area provides education on how to respond to cardiac arrest situations, combining various experiences with emergency training. Outdoors, there are popular exhibits for children, including fire trucks and ambulances, available for viewing at any time.

paragraphs: 大邱市民安全テーマパークは、市民が安全の重要性を感じることができるように、活気あふれる体験教育を通じて設立されました。実践的な安全体験のために、第1館には特化した地下鉄安全体験場、地震安全体験場、未来安全映像館（4D）、交通安全体験場、子供製品安全体験館などが運営されており、安全意識の向上とともに、日常生活で遭遇する可能性のある災害状況をリアルに体験できます。

en.title: Myeongpum Okgol 1616 Cooperative
en.overview: Okgol Village has a history of over 400 years, dating back to 1616 when Grandfather Daeam settled there. It is the oldest village in Daegu, and Myeongpum Okgol 1616 Cooperative is a village enterprise run by descendants of the Choi family from Gyeongju. In May 2019, the cooperative was formed to preserve the 400-year history and prepare for the next 1,000 years. They engage in various activities such as traditional experiences, utilizing a 200-year-old hanok for hanok stays, and developing traditional beverages through a hanok café.

en.title: Ganghwa Samrangseong
en.overview: Samrangseong, located in Gilsang-myeon, Ganghwa-gun, Incheon, was a fortress built to defend Kaegyeong and Hanyang since the Goryeo Dynasty. The circumference is about 2.3 km, and the fortress follows the terrain of the mountain from the summit to the southern gate at an elevation of 75m, resulting in a significant height difference between the north and south. The three sons of Dangun were assigned to build each peak of Jeongjoksan, and people named this mountain fortress Samrangseong using the character for 'young man' (郞). It is also known as Jeongjoksanseong, located at an elevation of 222m south of Ganghwa Island.
en.pull_quote: Local Recommended Partners · Nearby Restaurants · Safe Accommodation Routes
paragraphs: Samrangseong, located in Gilsang-myeon, Ganghwa-gun, Incheon, was a fortress built to defend Kaegyeong and Hanyang since the Goryeo Dynasty. The circumference is about 2.3 km, and the fortress follows the terrain of the mountain from the summit to the southern gate at an elevation of 75m, resulting in a significant height difference between the north and south. The three sons of Dangun were assigned to build each peak of Jeongjoksan, and people named this mountain fortress Samrangseong using the character for 'young man' (郞). It is also known as Jeongjoksanseong, located at an elevation of 222m south of Ganghwa Island.

The exact date of construction is unclear, but it is estimated to have been built using rough natural talc, a technique from the Three Kingdoms period. In 1739 (15th year of King Yeongjo), the southern gate was rebuilt, and a gate tower was constructed, named Jonghaeru. It was again repaired in 1764 (40th year of King Yeongjo). In 1866 (3rd year of King Gojong), it was the site where Yang Heon-soo's troops defeated the French army. Inside Samrangseong is Jeondeungsa, the oldest temple in Korea and the largest temple in Ganghwa.

paragraphs: 江華三郎城は仁川広域市江華郡吉祥面にある城郭で、考慮時代以降、開京と漢陽を防御するために築かれました。周囲は約2.3㎞で、城郭は山の頂上から南門側の海抜75mの稜線まで山の地形に沿って築かれ、北側と南側の高度差が大きくなっています。檀君の三人の息子が三つの峰を担当して築いたため、この山城の名前は「サンラン城」と呼ばれています。また、江華島の南側、海抜222mの正族山に位置しているため、正族山城とも呼ばれています。

en.title: Janggot Dondae
en.overview: Janggot Dondae, located in Janghwa-ri, Hwado-myeon, Ganghwa-gun, Incheon, is a fortification from the late Joseon period. It was designated as an Incheon Metropolitan City monument on March 2, 1995. Along with Migot Dondae, Bukilgot Dondae, and Geomam Dondae, it is part of Janggot Fortress. Large-scale fortifications were constructed for coastal defense from the reign of King Hyojong to King Yeongjo, most of which were built in 1679 (5th year of King Sukjong). King Sukjong mobilized 8,000 soldiers from Hamgyeong, Hwanghae, and Gangwon provinces and 4,300 soldiers from the Royal Guard to build 49 fortifications in just 40 days.
en.pull_quote: Local Recommended Partners · Nearby Restaurants · Safe Accommodation Routes
paragraphs: Janggot Dondae, located in Janghwa-ri, Hwado-myeon, Ganghwa-gun, Incheon, is a fortification from the late Joseon period. It was designated as an Incheon Metropolitan City monument on March 2, 1995. Along with Migot Dondae, Bukilgot Dondae, and Geomam Dondae, it is part of Janggot Fortress.

Large-scale fortifications were constructed for coastal defense from the reign of King Hyojong to King Yeongjo, most of which were built in 1679 (5th year of King Sukjong). King Sukjong mobilized 8,000 soldiers from Hamgyeong, Hwanghae, and Gangwon provinces and 4,300 soldiers from the Royal Guard to build 49 fortifications in just 40 days. The fortification was built 1,500m west of Bukilgot Dondae and 1,500m east of Geomam Dondae, using stones stacked in a circular manner, with four gun emplacements installed. The upper part was surrounded by brick walls at intervals of 90cm, but now it no longer exists.

en.title: Gyo-dong Hyanggyo
en.overview: Hyanggyo is an educational institution established by the state to honor the spirits of sages and conduct rituals, while also educating local citizens. Built in 1127 on the northern side of Hwacheong Mountain, it was relocated to its current site in 1741 and renovated in 1966. It is said that An Hyang brought a statue of Confucius from Yuan Dynasty on his way back from China in 1286, leading to the establishment of Confucian shrines in various towns in Seoul.
en.pull_quote: Hyanggyo is an educational institution established by the state to honor the spirits of sages and conduct rituals, while also educating local citizens.
paragraphs: Hyanggyo is an educational institution established by the state to honor the spirits of sages and conduct rituals, while also educating local citizens. Built in 1127 on the northern side of Hwacheong Mountain, it was relocated to its current site in 1741 and renovated in 1966. It is said that An Hyang brought a statue of Confucius from Yuan Dynasty on his way back from China in 1286, leading to the establishment of Confucian shrines in various towns in Seoul.

The remaining buildings include Myeongnyundang, which serves as an educational space, and Daeseongjeon, which is the ritual space, along with Dongmu and Seomu. Additionally, there are inner and outer gates and a ritual offering storage. During the Joseon Dynasty, it received land, slaves, and books from the state to educate students, but after the Gabo Reform in 1894, its educational function ceased, leaving only the ritual function. (Source: Cultural Heritage Administration)

ja.overview: 向校は聖賢の位牌を祀り、祭祀を行い、地方の民の教育を担当するために国家が設立した教育機関です。高麗の仁宗5年（1127年）に華蓋山の北側に建てられましたが、朝鮮の英祖17年（1741年）に現在の場所に移され、1966年に修理されました。高麗の忠烈王12年（1286年）に安享が元に行った帰りに孔子像を持ち帰ったと伝えられ、その後、ソウルの各邑に先祖や聖賢の位牌を祀る文廟が設置されたと言われています。
ja.pull_quote: 向校は聖賢の位牌を祀り、祭祀を行い、地方の民の教育を担当するために国家が設立した教育機関です。
paragraphs: 向校は聖賢の位牌を祀り、祭祀を行い、地方の民の教育を担当するために国家が設立した教育機関です。高麗の仁宗5年（1127年）に華蓋山の北側に建てられましたが、朝鮮の英祖17年（1741年）に現在の場所に移され、1966年に修理されました。高麗の忠烈王12年（1286年）に安享が元に行った帰りに孔子像を持ち帰ったと伝えられ、その後、ソウルの各邑に先祖や聖賢の位牌を祀る文廟が設置されたと言われています。
現在残っている建物は教育空間である明倫堂と東斎・西斎があり、祭祀空間を形成する大成殿と東務・西務があります。その他にも内三門・外三門や祭器庫などがあります。朝鮮時代には国家から土地・奴隷・書籍などを支給されて学生を教えましたが、甲午改革（1894年）以降、教育の機能はなくなり、祭祀の機能だけが残りました。(出典: 国家遺産庁)

en.title: Gyeryong Dondae
en.overview: Dondae is a small fortification built to observe enemy movements or prepare for attacks, typically constructed on elevated flatlands with high outer walls and lower inner walls for cannons. This particular Dondae is located on a hill southwest of Mangwol Plain and has inscriptions on its outer wall, managed alongside Mangwol Dondae.
en.pull_quote: Dondae is a small fortification built to observe enemy movements or prepare for attacks.
paragraphs: Dondae is a small fortification built to observe enemy movements or prepare for attacks, typically constructed on elevated flatlands with high outer walls and lower inner walls for cannons. This particular Dondae is located on a hill southwest of Mangwol Plain and has inscriptions on its outer wall, managed alongside Mangwol Dondae.
Records indicate that it was established in 1679 during the reign of King Sukjong, making it a rare example of a Dondae with documented construction dates. (Source: Cultural Heritage Administration)

en.title: Samsan Reservoir
en.overview: Seokmodo is connected to the main island of Ganghwa by a bridge, making it a popular destination for many travelers, with Samsan Reservoir being a notable site. Located on the western side of the island, it is adjacent to the sea, offering beautiful scenery and is famous for fishing. The reservoir covers an area of approximately 65,000 square meters and is relatively deep and large. It is known for its abundance of fish, making it a great fishing spot, and in winter, ice fishing is also enjoyed. A path lined with cosmos flowers is created around the reservoir.

en.title: Gyo-dong Island (Ganghwa)
en.overview: Gyo-dong Island is a border area just 2.6 km from North Korea, where displaced people from Yeonbaek, Hwanghae Province, gathered during the Korean War to establish their lives. Until the opening of Gyo-dong Bridge in 2014, it remained a neglected island, often referred to as a place where time stood still. Now, with the bridge, it is more accessible. Key attractions include Wolsunpo, where you can take photos with the Gyo-dong Bridge in the background, and various other sights.
en.pull_quote: Gyo-dong Island is a border area just 2.6 km from North Korea, where displaced people from Yeonbaek gathered during the Korean War.
paragraphs: Gyo-dong Island is a border area just 2.6 km from North Korea, where displaced people from Yeonbaek, Hwanghae Province, gathered during the Korean War to establish their lives. Until the opening of Gyo-dong Bridge in 2014, it remained a neglected island, often referred to as a place where time stood still. Now, with the bridge, it is more accessible.

Key attractions include Wolsunpo, where you can take photos with the Gyo-dong Bridge in the background, Daeryong Market filled with various sights, the Gyo-dong tourism platform Jeobijip, Hwache Garden with five themed parks, the scenic Hwacheong Mountain Monorail, Gogu Reservoir filled with lotus flowers in August, and Nanjeong Reservoir with 100,000 sunflowers. There are also walking courses like the Gyo-dong Dalsegil and the path to Meorume.

en.title: Ganghwa Jangjeong-ri Stone Buddha Statue
en.overview: This stone Buddha statue from the Goryeo Dynasty is located beneath Bongcheonsan Mountain in Ganghwa County. Carved from thick granite slabs, it is now housed in a pavilion. Overall, it is grand and proportionate, though the large face, narrow shoulders, and big hands disrupt its balance somewhat. The statue stands 2.8 meters tall, with a prominent ushnisha on its head and a round face that carries a smile from the mouth to the cheeks and eyes. It reflects the characteristics of Goryeo-era statues.
en.pull_quote: This stone Buddha statue from the Goryeo Dynasty is located beneath Bongcheonsan Mountain in Ganghwa County.
paragraphs: This stone Buddha statue from the Goryeo Dynasty is located beneath Bongcheonsan Mountain in Ganghwa County. Carved from thick granite slabs, it is now housed in a pavilion. Overall, it is grand and proportionate, though the large face, narrow shoulders, and big hands disrupt its balance somewhat.

Standing at 2.8 meters tall, it has a prominent ushnisha on its head and a round face that carries a smile from the mouth to the cheeks and eyes. The statue well represents the characteristics of Goryeo-era statues, and it is estimated to have been created around the 11th century. A legend tells that descendants built a temple called Bongunsa to honor their ancestors and carved this statue to repay their gratitude with annual rituals.

ja.overview: 江華郡の鳳天山の下にある高麗時代の石造仏像です。厚い花崗岩の板石に彫られており、現在は殿堂の中にあります。全体的に壮大で比率が良いですが、大きな顔、狭い肩、大きな手などがややバランスを崩しています。高さ2.8mの磨崖仏で、頭の上に大きな肉髻がそびえ、顔は丸く、口元から頬や目元にかけて微笑みをたたえています。形状のある顔、短い首、縮こまった肩、形式的な衣のひだなどから、高麗時代の仏像の特徴をよく表している作品であり、制作時期は11世紀頃と推定されています。子孫が先祖の恩恵を称えるために奉恩寺という寺院を建て、この石造如来立像を彫り、毎年祭祀を行って恩恵に報いるという伝説が伝わっています。

en.title: Ganghwa Bunori Dondae
en.overview: Dondae is a small observation and defense facility built along the coast or border areas. Soldiers stationed inside the Dondae monitor for enemy invasions and suspicious activities. In case of an invasion, they would defend using weapons stored inside. Bunori Dondae is one of the 48 Dondae built in 1679, located next to Dongmak Beach. Originally planned as a rectangular structure, it took on a crescent shape due to the natural terrain.
en.pull_quote: Dondae is a small observation and defense facility built along the coast or border areas.
paragraphs: Dondae is a small observation and defense facility built along the coast or border areas. Soldiers stationed inside the Dondae monitor for enemy invasions and suspicious activities. In case of an invasion, they would defend using weapons stored inside. Bunori Dondae is one of the 48 Dondae built in 1679, located next to Dongmak Beach.

Originally planned as a rectangular structure, it took on a crescent shape due to the natural terrain. While most Dondae are rectangular or circular, Bunori Dondae's crescent shape gives it a unique appearance. It is situated at the end of a ridge protruding from the mountain towards the coast, providing a wide field of view over the deeply curved tidal flats on either side. It had four gates and was significant enough to have a separate management office.

en.title: May 18th Democracy Square
en.addr: 38 Munhwa Jeondang-ro, Dong-gu, Gwangju, South Jeolla Province
en.overview: May 18th Democracy Square is located in front of the National Asian Culture Complex in Dong-gu, Gwangju. It commemorates the May 1980 Gwangju Uprising, which took place in front of the former Jeonnam Provincial Office. The square features a fountain, the Sangmu Hall, and a clock tower as symbols of the event, along with the Bell Tower of Democracy built in 2005, which rings on May 18th and Liberation Day.
en.pull_quote: May 18th Democracy Square is located in front of the National Asian Culture Complex in Dong-gu, Gwangju.
paragraphs: May 18th Democracy Square is located in front of the National Asian Culture Complex in Dong-gu, Gwangju. It commemorates the May 1980 Gwangju Uprising, which took place in front of the former Jeonnam Provincial Office. The square features a fountain, the Sangmu Hall, and a clock tower as symbols of the event, along with the Bell Tower of Democracy built in 2005, which rings on May 18th and Liberation Day.

The old building that served as the Jeonnam Provincial Office was constructed in 1930 during the Japanese occupation and is now restored as the National Asian Culture Complex, designated as a national registered cultural heritage site since 1996. On May 14, 1980, students from Chonnam National University marched from the university to the square, joining forces with students from Chosun University and citizens to hold the National Democratic Grand Assembly, making it a symbolic site of the Gwangju Democratization Movement.

en.title: Gwangju Lake
en.addr: 7 Chung-hyo Saem-gil, Buk-gu, Gwangju, South Jeolla Province
en.overview: Gwangju Lake, completed in 1976, is an artificial lake used for agricultural water in Gwangju and Damyang. Located beneath Mudeungsan Mountain, it harmonizes with the surrounding beautiful scenery and is a popular fishing spot due to its rich aquatic life. The upper reaches of Gwangju Lake in Chung-hyo-dong feature several traditional pavilions, including Sikyeongjeong, Hwanbyeokdang, Soswaewon, Chwigajeong, and Doksujeong, showcasing the essence of Joseon-era garden culture.

en.title: Wonhyo Temple (Gwangju)
en.addr: 1514-35 Mudeung-ro, Buk-gu, Gwangju, South Jeolla Province
en.overview: Wonhyo Temple is a traditional temple located in the majestic mountains of Mudeungsan, Gwangju, known for having the most beautiful pavilion in Korea. It is said that the temple was established by Wonhyo Daesa during the Silla period, who loved the beauty of the mountains. The name 'Wonhyoam' is derived from this history. Some say it was founded by a famous Huayan sect monk during the Goryeo period, who named it out of admiration for Wonhyo.
en.pull_quote: Wonhyo Temple is a traditional temple located in the majestic mountains of Mudeungsan, Gwangju, known for having the most beautiful pavilion in Korea.
paragraphs: Wonhyo Temple is a traditional temple located in the majestic mountains of Mudeungsan, Gwangju, known for having the most beautiful pavilion in Korea. It is said that the temple was established by Wonhyo Daesa during the Silla period, who loved the beauty of the mountains.

Some say it was founded by a famous Huayan sect monk during the Goryeo period, who named it out of admiration for Wonhyo. The subsequent history is hard to verify, but it is known that the temple regained prominence during the regency of Queen Munjeong, and it was also where the commander of the Joseon period, Yeonggyu, practiced. After being burned down during the Imjin War, it was reconstructed by Seokgyeong, who personally made the tiles for the restoration.

en.title: Gwangju Chung-hyo-dong Kiln Site
en.addr: 14 Pungamje-gil, Buk-gu, Gwangju, South Jeolla Province
en.overview: The kiln site located in Chung-hyo-dong, north of Mudeungsan, was used for producing celadon, buncheong, and white porcelain from the late Goryeo to the early Joseon period. The structure of the kiln includes access facilities, a firing room for placing pottery, and a chimney, resembling a connected round tomb shape. Based on records from the 'Annals of King Sejong' and the dating of excavated artifacts, it is believed to have started production around 1430.

Based on records from the 'Annals of King Sejong' and the dating of excavated artifacts, it is believed to have started production around 1430. It is presumed that production continued for about 70 to 80 years before ceasing in the early 16th century.

en.title: Gwangju Chung-hyo-dong Weeping Willow Grove
en.addr: 7 Chung-hyo Saem-gil, Buk-gu, Gwangju, South Jeolla Province
en.overview: The weeping willow trees located along the roadside between Gwangju Lake's eastern shore and Chung-hyo-dong village are large deciduous trees. They bloom in April and bear fruit in May. These trees are found in the southern regions of Korea and parts of central China, and are widely loved as scenic trees and pavilion trees. They grow near water and fields, and their wood is used for furniture and firewood.
en.pull_quote: The weeping willow trees located along the roadside between Gwangju Lake's eastern shore and Chung-hyo-dong village are large deciduous trees.
paragraphs: The weeping willow trees located along the roadside between Gwangju Lake's eastern shore and Chung-hyo-dong village are large deciduous trees. They bloom in April and bear fruit in May. These trees are found in the southern regions of Korea and parts of central China, and are widely loved as scenic trees and pavilion trees.

The three weeping willows in Chung-hyo-dong are designated as city trees, originally known as Ilsong, Ilmae, and Oryu, symbolizing the village. However, one willow and one plum tree have died, and another willow and a pine tree were cut down during road expansion, leaving only the three willows. The village plans to plant two more willows and continue planting pine and plum trees.

en.title: Jeil Banjeom
en.overview: Jeil Banjeom is a Chinese restaurant located on Chungjang-ro in Gwangju, Jeollanam-do. Established in the 1960s, it has been serving traditional Chinese cuisine for over 60 years, operated by a Chinese immigrant. The menu includes old-style Jajangmyeon made with fried black bean paste, vegetables, potatoes, and pork, as well as sweet and sour pork made from pork loin. The fried dumplings and squid tempura are highly recommended.
en.pull_quote: Signature Dishes: Old-style Jajang · Jjamppong / Sweet and Sour Pork / Yangjangpi, etc.
paragraphs: Jeil Banjeom is a Chinese restaurant located on Chungjang-ro in Gwangju, Jeollanam-do. Established in the 1960s, it has been serving traditional Chinese cuisine for over 60 years, operated by a Chinese immigrant. The menu includes old-style Jajangmyeon made with fried black bean paste, vegetables, potatoes, and pork, as well as sweet and sour pork made from pork loin.

In particular, the fried dumplings and squid tempura are highly recommended, and the accompanying onion sauce is a delicacy. Although the restaurant is spacious, it is popular among locals, so it's best to time your visit well during lunch hours. It is located between Geumnamno 5-ga and Geumnamno 4-ga stations on Subway Line 1, just a 2-minute walk away, making it easily accessible by public transport.

en.title: Jangdokdae
en.addr: 3rd Floor, 43 Munhwa Jeondang-ro, Dong-gu, Gwangju, Jeollanam-do
en.overview: Jangdokdae is a popular restaurant near the Asia Culture Complex, specializing in Namdo ssambap (wrapped rice). The ssambap set menu includes jumulleok (marinated meat) and grilled mackerel, and ordering the set menu comes with over ten side dishes excluding the wraps. Additional side dishes can be obtained from the self-service bar, allowing for a hearty and healthy meal. Besides the ssambap set, various other meal options are available, including beef bulgogi stew, pork rib kimchi stew, stir-fried octopus, and braised mackerel with aged kimchi.

paragraphs: Wongaksa Temple is the Gwangju branch of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism, located in the bustling area of Geumnam-ro in Gwangju. It features a newly reconstructed Daeungjeon Hall, Wongakru (a social activity space), and two guesthouses. The area in front of Wongaksa is busy with cars and people, and many visitors come to pay their respects and participate in various events and activities. Additionally, the temple operates a volunteer group called Ulim, which engages in charitable activities and music events. Cultural events include yoga, four gentlemen ceremonies, and over 60 diverse ceremonies. Wongaksa Temple has an official website and publishes a newsletter bi-monthly, fulfilling its role as a perfect temple for propagation.

en.title: Gwangju Art Street
en.overview: Just as Myeongdong exists in Seoul and Piff Street in Busan, each region has its own unique streets. The Gwangju Art Street is the representative street of Gwangju, Jeonnam. This street was created to inherit and develop the traditions of Jeonnam's culture and art, the center of Honam culture. Currently, it showcases and sells symbolic works of local art such as calligraphy, ceramics, and crafts for the convenience of art enthusiasts. It is a place where anyone can easily access the essence of Namdo art, centered around Korean painting, calligraphy, and Namdo singing.
en.pull_quote: Local Recommended Partner · Nearby Restaurants and Safe Accommodation Routes
paragraphs: Just as Myeongdong exists in Seoul and Piff Street in Busan, each region has its own unique streets. The Gwangju Art Street is the representative street of Gwangju, Jeonnam.

The Art Street was created to inherit and develop the traditions of Jeonnam's culture and art, the center of Honam culture. Currently, it showcases and sells symbolic works of local art such as calligraphy, ceramics, and crafts for the convenience of art enthusiasts. It is a place where anyone can easily access the essence of Namdo art, centered around Korean painting, calligraphy, and Namdo singing. It takes about an hour to stroll around, and if you enter the shops to appreciate the art, it may take about two hours. On Saturdays, the street is designated as a 'car-free street' where various cultural events can be enjoyed. Once a month, the Namdo Cultural and Arts Promotion Association hosts music concerts, light festivals, underground performances, character cultural product exhibitions, and light festivals, further revitalizing the Art Street.

アートストリートは、ホナム文化と芸術の中心地である芸香光州の伝統を継承・発展させるために整備されました。現在、書道、陶芸、工芸品などこの地域の芸術の象徴的な作品を集めて展示・販売しており、韓国画、書道、南道唱を中心に南道芸術の真髄に誰でも簡単に触れることができる名所です。中央小学校の裏手の交差点に至るこの場所を巡るのに、見物だけで1時間程度、店舗に入って鑑賞すると2時間程度かかります。初めて訪れる方はぜひ立ち寄る価値があります。毎週土曜日には「車のない通り」として指定され、さまざまな文化イベントを楽しむことができ、月に一度、南道文化芸術振興会が主催する音楽会、光の祭典、アンダーグラウンド公演、キャラクター文化商品展、光の祭典などが行われ、アートストリートをさらに活性化させています。
