en.title: Haenam Myeongnyang Battle Monument
en.addr: 34 Usuyoungan-gil, Munnam-myeon, Haenam-gun, Gwangju Metropolitan City
en.overview: The Haenam Myeongnyang Battle Monument was erected to honor Admiral Yi Sun-sin for his victory in the Battle of Myeongnyang in 1597. The inscription was written in 1686, and the monument was erected by Park Sin-joo, the naval commander of Jeolla Province, in 1688. The monument features a rectangular base with a body and a headstone adorned with clouds and dragons. The inscription records Admiral Yi's efforts to regroup his navy after the Battle of Chilcheollyang and his victory over the Japanese forces using the swift currents between Usuyoung and Jindo.

en.title: Kim Nam-joo's Birthplace
en.addr: 98 Bonghak-gil, Samsan-myeon, Haenam-gun, Gwangju Metropolitan City
en.overview: Kim Nam-joo is a representative figure of Korean national literature, known as a 'warrior poet' who passionately advocated for social change and a 'national poet' who awakened the Korean literary world with his revolutionary voice. He was also a revolutionary poet who spent a decade in prison fighting against dictatorship. Born in 1945 in Bonghak-ri, Haenam-gun, Gwangju Metropolitan City, he attended Samhwa Elementary School and Haenam Middle School before enrolling in Gwangju Ilgo, but he dropped out in opposition to exam-oriented education.
en.pull_quote: Kim Nam-joo is a representative figure of Korean national literature, known as a 'warrior poet' who passionately advocated for social change and a 'national poet' who awakened the Korean literary world with his revolutionary voice. He was also…
paragraphs: Kim Nam-joo is a representative figure of Korean national literature, known as a 'warrior poet' who passionately advocated for social change and a 'national poet' who awakened the Korean literary world with his revolutionary voice. He was also a revolutionary poet who spent a decade in prison fighting against dictatorship. Born in 1945 in Bonghak-ri, Haenam-gun, Gwangju Metropolitan City, he attended Samhwa Elementary School and Haenam Middle School before enrolling in Gwangju Ilgo, but he dropped out in opposition to exam-oriented education.

During his time in university, he participated in the 'Three-Term Constitutional Amendment Opposition Movement' and produced the first underground newspapers 'Hamsung' and 'Gobal' in the country during the anti-Yushin movement, which led to an 8-month prison sentence and his expulsion from university. In 1974, he debuted in the literary world with works like 'Jinhonga' in 'Creation and Criticism' and later formed the 'People's Culture Research Institute' with writers like Hwang Sok-yong. In 1978, he was active as a 'warrior' in the strongest underground organization against Yushin, 'Namminjeon', until he was arrested with his comrades in October the following year.

paragraphs: キム・ナムジュは韓国民族文学を代表する人物であり、社会変革運動の理念と精神を全身で推進した「戦士詩人」であり、革命的な声で韓国文壇を目覚めさせた「民族詩人」です。また、反独裁闘争に先頭を切った革命詩人でもありました。1945年、全羅南道光州統合特別市ヘナム郡ボンハク里で農民の子として生まれ、三和小学校、ヘナム中学校を経て光州一高に入学しましたが、入試中心の教育に反対して中退しました。

大学在学中に「三選改憲反対闘争」に参加し、1972年と翌年には全国初の反ユシン闘争地下新聞『ハムソン』と『コバル』を制作し、8ヶ月の懲役を受け、大学を退学されました。1974年に『創作と批評』に『鎮魂歌』などで文壇に登場し、作家のファン・ソクヨンなどと共に『民衆文化研究所』を結成しました。1978年には最も強力な反ユシン闘争地下組織『南民戦』の「戦士」として活動し、翌年の10月に同志たちと共に逮捕されました。

paragraphs: 金南柱是韩国民族文学的代表人物，被称为全身心推动社会变革运动理念和精神的“战士诗人”，也是以革命的声音唤醒韩国文坛的“民族诗人”。他还是一位在反独裁斗争中走在前列的革命诗人。1945年出生于全罗南道光州综合特别市海南郡奉学里，先后就读于三和小学、海南中学，后考入光州一高，但因反对应试教育而辍学。
在大学期间，他参与了“三选宪法反对斗争”，并于1972年和次年制作了全国首个反维新斗争地下报纸《喊声》和《告发》，因此被判刑8个月，随后被大学开除。1974年，他以《镇魂歌》等作品在《创作与批评》上首次登场，后来与作家黄锡永等人共同成立了“民众文化研究所”。1978年，他作为最强的反维新斗争地下组织“南民战”的“战士”活跃，次年10月与同志们一起被捕。

en.title: Ddakkkut Sculpture Park
en.addr: 2785 Ddakkkuthaean-ro, Songji-myeon, Haenam-gun, Gwangju Metropolitan City
en.overview: Ddakkkut Sculpture Park was established in 2001 as part of the cultural tourism complex in Ddakkkut Village to provide various attractions for visitors. As you drive from Ddakkkut Village towards Wando, you'll see a large sign indicating the park, where you can enjoy various sculptures. There are 26 sculptures set against a low hill, and the Ddakkkut Sea stretches to the west, making the sunset view here dreamy and beautiful.

paragraphs: Ddakkkut Sculpture Park was established in 2001 as part of the cultural tourism complex in Ddakkkut Village to provide various attractions for visitors. As you drive from Ddakkkut Village towards Wando, you'll see a large sign indicating the park, where you can enjoy various sculptures. There are 26 sculptures set against a low hill, and the Ddakkkut Sea stretches to the west, making the sunset view here dreamy and beautiful. As you climb the stairs, you'll find more artworks on either side, allowing you to appreciate the art while enjoying the mountains and sea of Haenam.

Above the sculpture park, there are also resting areas with benches, and the view from the hilltop is very beautiful. You can also see the Ddakkkut Observatory across the sea, making it a great spot to overlook Haenam. It's a nice place to stop during a drive and take your time exploring, and if the timing is right, I recommend watching the sunset.

en.title: Osan (Gurye)
en.addr: 303 Saseongam-gil, Muncheok-myeon, Gurye-gun, Gwangju Metropolitan City
en.overview: Osan is recorded in the Bongseongji as 'the shape of the rock is outstanding, resembling Geumgangsan, and has been called 'Little Geumgang' since ancient times.' It is a 531m high mountain facing Jirisan, known for its gentle slopes and beautiful scenery, making it a popular destination for family outings and group picnics. Saseongam is a temple built on the sheer cliffs of Osan, established by the monk Yeongi in the 22nd year of King Seong of Baekje (544 AD), originally called Osanam, and later renamed Saseongam after four great monks (Uisang, Wonhyo, Doseon, and Jinjakguksa) meditated here.

paragraphs: Osan is recorded in the Bongseongji as 'the shape of the rock is outstanding, resembling Geumgangsan, and has been called 'Little Geumgang' since ancient times.' It is a 531m high mountain facing Jirisan, known for its gentle slopes and beautiful scenery, making it a popular destination for family outings and group picnics. Saseongam is a temple built on the sheer cliffs of Osan, established by the monk Yeongi in the 22nd year of King Seong of Baekje (544 AD), originally called Osanam, and later renamed Saseongam after four great monks (Uisang, Wonhyo, Doseon, and Jinjakguksa) meditated here.

After passing Saseongam, you can reach the summit of Osan in about 10 minutes, where you can enjoy excellent views of the Seomjin River, Gurye-eup, and the peaks of Jirisan such as Nogodan and Banya-bong. Osan offers various routes for hiking, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Gurye while visiting the temple and taking in the panoramic views of the Seomjin River and the vast plains.

ja.title: オサン（グリョ）
ja.region_label: 全羅南道 グリョ郡 ムンチョク面
ja.addr: 全羅南道光州統合特別市 グリョ郡 ムンチョク面 サソン岩路 303
ja.overview: オサンは、ボンソンジに「その岩の形状は優れており、金剛山のようで、古くから小金剛と呼ばれている」と記録されています。智異山を正面に見据えた標高531mの山で、高くも険しくもなく、絶景が多く、家族連れや団体のピクニックコースとして愛されています。サソン岩はオサンの頂上の切り立った崖に建てられた寺院で、百済の聖王22年（544年）に延基調査によって建立され、元々オサン岩と呼ばれていましたが、ここで4人の高僧（義湘、元曉、道詵、鎮覚国師）が修行したことからサソン岩と呼ばれるようになりました。

サソン岩を過ぎて10分ほど登るとオサンの頂上に到達し、ここからは鮮やかな島津川とグリョ邑、智異山のノゴダンやバニャボンの姿を一望できる素晴らしい景観ポイントです。登山をしながら素晴らしい寺院を見学し、頂上から島津川と広大な平野の美しいグリョの全景を楽しむことができるオサンは、さまざまな方法でアクセスできます。まず、最初から徒歩で行くことができ、最小でも3時間以上かかるコースです。

zh.title: 五山（求礼）
zh.region_label: 全罗南道 求礼郡 文尺面
zh.addr: 全罗南道光州综合特别市 求礼郡 文尺面 四星岩路 303
zh.overview: 五山在《奉圣志》中被记载为“岩石的形状出众，像金刚山，自古以来被称为小金刚”。它是面向智异山的海拔531米的山，既不高也不陡，风景如画，深受家庭和团体郊游的喜爱。四星岩是建在五山顶陡峭悬崖上的寺庙，由百济圣王22年（公元544年）延基所建，原名五山岩，后来因四位高僧（义湘、元晓、道选、镇觉国师）在此修行而改名为四星岩。

en.title: Dangmol Spring
en.addr: 3-2 Jangsu-gil, Masang-myeon, Gurye-gun, Gwangju Metropolitan City
en.overview: Sangsa Village is recognized as one of the longest-living villages in the country, along with Yangcheon Village in Ganjeon-myeon, Gurye-gun. The locals attribute their longevity to the clean environment of the Simsan Valley and 'Dangmol Spring'. Dangmol Spring is renowned for its exceptional health benefits, with locals claiming that 'the water from the roots of medicinal herbs in Jirisan flows here.' In 1986, a water quality test by a preventive medicine team from Korea University found it to be the best water in the country, with no E. coli detected. According to the local Kim clan, their ancestor discovered Dangmol Spring while searching for a good location in Jeolla Province during the late Joseon period.

ja.title: ダンモル泉
ja.region_label: 全羅南道 グリョ郡 マサン面
ja.addr: 全羅南道光州統合特別市 グリョ郡 マサン面 ジャンス路 3-2
ja.overview: サンサ村は、グリョ郡のカンジョン面のヤンチョン村と共に全国最長寿村として知られています。ここに住む人々は、長寿の秘訣としてシムサン渓谷の清らかな環境と「ダンモル泉」を挙げています。ダンモル泉は「智異山の薬草の根がすべて流れ込む」と言われるほど効能が優れています。1986年に高麗大学の予防医学チームによる水質検査の結果、大腸菌が一匹も検出されない全国最高の水と判明しました。この村の地元の金氏一族によると、彼らの先祖は朝鮮時代末期に名所を探して全羅道を彷徨っている際に、ダンモル泉の水の重さが他の場所よりも多く、豊富な水量を持っていることを見つけてここに定住したと言われています。

zh.title: 当毛泉
zh.region_label: 全罗南道 求礼郡 马山面
zh.addr: 全罗南道光州综合特别市 求礼郡 马山面 长水路 3-2
zh.overview: 上士村与求礼郡的杨川村一起被认为是全国最长寿的村庄。这里的人们将长寿的秘诀归结为清澈的心山谷环境和“当毛泉”。当毛泉以其卓越的疗效而闻名，村民们甚至称“智异山的药草根水都流入这里”。1986年，考古大学的预防医学团队对水质进行检测，结果显示没有大肠杆菌，是全国最优质的水。根据当地金氏家族的说法，他们的祖先在朝鲜末期寻找名山时发现了当毛泉，发现这里的水重于其他地方，水量也丰富，因此定居于此。

en.title: Haepung Ganjang
en.overview: Located near Turtle Ship Park in Yeosu, Haepung Ganjang started as Haepung Restaurant in 1990 and has since changed its name. en.title: Mahe
en.overview: Cafe Mahe is a large cafe located on Baekya Island in Yeosu, Jeollanam-do. True to its name, which means 'to carve images or statues on rock cliffs', the interior features a grand design that makes you feel as if you are sitting in front of a massive stone wall. It operates alongside a restaurant space called 'Natan Beach', where you can enjoy drinks and baked goods at Mahe, and brunch and restaurant dishes at Natan Beach, which is accessible via stairs. Notably, customers at Cafe Mahe can freely move between the two spaces and can enjoy food ordered from the cafe in the Natan Beach area, making it a great spot to soak in an exotic resort atmosphere.

en.title: Golden Pine Tree
en.overview: Golden Pine Tree is a beautiful house that serves only one dish: the grilled short rib patties set. It is an excellent place to take your parents for a traditional Korean meal. Before the main dish of grilled short rib patties is served, a variety of carefully prepared side dishes are presented, including salad, japchae (stir-fried glass noodles), fried eggplant, pumpkin porridge, jellyfish salad, croaker, sweet and sour tofu, tomato shrimp, lotus root broccoli sesame salad, jellyfish cold dish, and soybean paste stew. After the meal, you can enjoy coffee and snacks while admiring the pottery. The yard has benches, parasols, and pavilions, making it a comfortable resting place for everyone.

en.title: Cherry Blossom Village
en.addr: 209 Maisan-nam-ro, Maryeong-myeon, Jinan-gun, Jeonbuk Special Self-Governing Province
en.overview: Located at the entrance of Geumdangsa Temple in Maisan Provincial Park, 'Cherry Blossom Village' is a traditional-style restaurant commonly found around mountains. Here, you can enjoy oak-grilled pork and Dongdongju (a type of Korean rice wine), with the oak-grilled ribs of black pork being particularly delicious. The mini ribs are not only generous in meat but also low in fat, making them very appealing. Additionally, you can savor various meats like pork neck and belly, as well as dishes like bibimbap and grilled deodeok (a type of root vegetable).

en.title: Heuksuksan Natural Recreation Forest
en.addr: 306 Sangol-gil, Gyegok-myeon, Haenam-gun, Jeonnam Gwangju Unified Special City
en.overview: Heuksuksan Natural Recreation Forest is located on Heuksuksan Mountain (650m above sea level), the sacred mountain of Gyegok-myeon. The name 'Heuksuk' was recorded as 'Choeum' in the Daedongyeojido, a map of Korea created during the Joseon Dynasty by the cartographer Kim Jeong-ho. Originally called Gahaksan, the name 'Gahak' was given because the mountain resembles a crane soaring. 'Heuksuk' derives from the black appearance of the mountain's rocks after rain. In spring, beautiful azalea fields and the best cluster of sosan trees in Korea can be found here.

en.overview: The living quarters and garden of Haechang Brewery were built in 1927 by Shibada Hikobei, who was born in Gunma Prefecture, Japan, and settled in Haenam after passing through Gangjin. After liberation, the eldest son, Moon, who founded Samhwa Elementary School in Haenam, lived here, and the brewing license is believed to have been issued by him in 1961. Subsequently, Hwang Uigwon, who was engaged in the brewing industry, took over Haechang Brewery and brewed alcohol for over 30 years. Since 2008, the couple Oh Byeong-in and Park Ri-a have been operating the brewery.
en.pull_quote: Local Recommended Partner · Nearby Restaurants · Safe Accommodation Link Course
paragraphs: The living quarters and garden of Haechang Brewery were built in 1927 by Shibada Hikobei, who was born in Gunma Prefecture, Japan, and settled in Haenam after passing through Gangjin. After liberation, the eldest son, Moon, who founded Samhwa Elementary School in Haenam, lived here, and the brewing license is believed to have been issued by him in 1961. Subsequently, Hwang Uigwon, who was engaged in the brewing industry, took over Haechang Brewery and brewed alcohol for over 30 years. Since 2008, the couple Oh Byeong-in and Park Ri-a have been operating the brewery.

Haechang Brewery, filled with over 40 species of trees, began to gain recognition for its beautiful garden. It was featured in KBS in 2011, KBS in 2012, and the Chosun Ilbo in 2013, leading to an increase in visitors from afar. In 2014, it was designated as a 'visiting brewery' by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs due to its beautiful garden and the presence of modern cultural heritage nearby. The name 'makgeolli' is believed to have two meanings: one referring to 'freshly filtered alcohol' and the other to 'lightly filtered alcohol.' The Haechang makgeolli brewed here is known for its non-sweet taste and craftsmanship.

paragraphs: The underwater tomb of King Munmu, the 30th monarch of Silla (reigned 661-681), offers a glimpse into the creative thinking of the Silla people. Located 200m from the sea off Bonggilli in the East Sea, it is exposed above sea level, measuring approximately 35m east-west, 36m north-south, and 5.3m in height. King Munmu succeeded his father, King Muyeol, in defeating Goguryeo and preventing Tang invasions, achieving the unification of the Three Kingdoms. He also established central government offices such as the Ministry of Military and the Ministry of Rites.

King Munmu, who unified the Three Kingdoms, requested that his body be cremated in a Buddhist manner and that his ashes be buried in the East Sea to prevent invasions by Japanese pirates. This rock is known as Daewangam or Daewang Rock, and the underwater royal tomb is unique in the world. Daewangam was created using natural rocks, with artificial waterways shaped in a cross pattern in the rock island, and a small pond was dug in the center to form a harbor.

paragraphs: 新羅の第30代文武王（在位661〜681年）の水中陵で、新羅人の創造的な考えを垣間見ることができる場所です。東海奉吉里の前海から200m離れた場所にあり、海面上に東西35m、南北36m、高さ5.3m程度露出しています。文武王は父である太宗武烈王の業績を引き継ぎ、高句麗を滅ぼし、唐の侵略を防いで三国統一を成し遂げました。また、兵部、創部など中央官庁を設立し、地方統治のための5小京制度と9西堂10正の軍事制度の基礎を築くなど、国家体制完成の基礎を提供しました。

en.title: Gyeongju Gyeongae Wangneung
en.overview: This site is believed to be the tomb of Gyeongae Wang, the 55th king of Silla (reigned 924-927). Gyeongae Wang was the second son of King Sin Deok and the brother of King Gyeongmyeong, succeeding him to the throne. He assisted Goryeo during the conquest of Later Baekje by sending troops. In 927, while holding a feast after a ritual at Poseokjeong, he was captured by Gyeon Hwon of Later Baekje and took his own life. The tomb is located in a pine forest at the entrance of Samneung Valley.

In 927, while holding a feast after a ritual at Poseokjeong, he was captured by Gyeon Hwon of Later Baekje and took his own life. The tomb is located in a pine forest at the entrance of Samneung Valley. Some stones resembling the surrounding stones are partially exposed along the edge of the tomb. Although no excavation has been conducted, it is presumed that the internal structure is a stone chamber tomb.

en.title: Yeongju Sunheung Mural Tomb
en.overview: This mural tomb, excavated in January 1985 by the Cultural Heritage Administration and Daegu University, is designated as a historic site and is a valuable resource both academically and culturally. The construction date of this tomb is estimated to be around 539 AD based on the inscription 'Gimi Jungmyo Sanginmyeong' found on the southern wall of the tomb's chamber. The internal structure is a stone chamber tomb with an entrance, leading to the chamber where the body is enshrined.

paragraphs: This mural tomb, excavated in January 1985 by the Cultural Heritage Administration and Daegu University, is designated as a historic site and is a valuable resource both academically and culturally. The construction date of this tomb is estimated to be around 539 AD based on the inscription 'Gimi Jungmyo Sanginmyeong' found on the southern wall of the tomb's chamber. The internal structure is a stone chamber tomb with an entrance, leading to the chamber where the body is enshrined.

The chamber measures approximately 3.5m east-west and 2m north-south, with walls that slightly taper towards the top, and the ceiling is completed with two large flat stones. The murals cover all walls and the sides of the chamber, except for the ceiling, with particularly strong warrior figures painted on the left and right walls of the entrance. Notably, the warrior figure on the west wall, holding a snake, is interpreted as a guardian of this tomb.

en.title: Musoe Dal Village
en.overview: Musoe Dal Village, located in Punggi-eup, Yeongju, is the starting point of the Sobaeksan 3 Jarak-gil and is traversed by the old Juknyeong road. The name 'Musoe Dal' means 'Iron Bridge.' Long ago, there was an iron bridge in this village, which is how the village got its name. Although it is now called Sucheol-ri Musoe Dal Village, the old name of Sucheol-ri was also Sucheolgyo (水鐵橋) ri. The symbolic iron bridge of the village is no longer preserved in its original form, but you can find a sculpture that recreates its appearance in Musoe Dal Village.

Long ago, there was an iron bridge in this village, which is how the village got its name. Although it is now called Sucheol-ri Musoe Dal Village, the old name of Sucheol-ri was also Sucheolgyo (水鐵橋) ri.

The symbolic iron bridge of the village is no longer preserved in its original form, but you can find a sculpture that recreates its appearance in Musoe Dal Village. The name Musoe Dal Village comes from the iron bridge that existed in the village since the Silla period. There is a story involving a tiger and a monk, where Monk Duun saved a tiger caught by a hairpin around its neck, and in gratitude, the tiger offered the daughter of the local lord, Yu Seok. However, Monk Duun returned the daughter to Seorabeol, and in gratitude, Yu Seok placed an iron bridge in the stream leading to Heebangsa Temple.

en.title: 《2026 Seoul Tourism Guidebook》 Web Edition — 5 Major Districts, Theme Courses, Culinary, and Hanok Complete Summary
en.subtitle: Complete core 50-page official guidebook for Seoul's 5 major districts (Downtown, Central, Northeast, Northwest, Gangnam)
en.address: 161 Sajik-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul (Gyeongbokgung Palace, Bukchon, Namsan, Hangang Districts)
en.pull_quote: Check out the 12MB, 50-page 《2026 Seoul Tourism Guidebook》 covering royal palaces, Hanyangdoseong Fortress Wall, museums, Hangang River, neighborhood alleys, food alleys, festivals, and practical info all in one web magazine.
paragraphs:
【CHAPTER 1 · Seoul's 5 Major Royal Palaces & Free Hanbok Admission Tips】
The first gateway to a Seoul trip consists of Gyeongbokgung, Changdeokgung, Changgyeonggung (09:00~21:00), Deoksugung, Gyeonghuigung, and Jongmyo Shrine, where 500 years of the Joseon Dynasty's history dwell. Visitors wearing Hanbok can enter all five royal palaces for free, and advance reservations for Changdeokgung's Secret Garden and Gyeongbokgung's nighttime viewing can be made at the Royal Palace and Tombs Center (royal.khs.go.kr).

【CHAPTER 2 · Downtown Fortress Wall & Hanyangdoseong Hiking】
Hanyangdoseong Fortress Wall Trail, a historical site connecting Seoul's ridges, offers sections tailored to your stamina level. Representative courses include the gentle walking-style Naksan Section (Hyehwamun to Heunginjimun, 2.1km, approx. 1 hr), the Namsan Section connecting to Namsan Park (4.2km, approx. 3 hrs), and the Baekak Section with exceptional ridge views (Changuimun to Hyehwamun, 4.7km, approx. 3 hrs).

【CHAPTER 3 · National Museums & Best Culture/Art Spaces】
The historic course centers around the National Museum of Korea in Yongsan (night opening Wed/Sat until 21:00), which houses about 430,000 artifacts including national treasures, the National Hangeul Museum, and the Seodaemun Prison History Hall. Contemporary art continues to the MMCA Seoul and Deoksugung, Seoul Museum of Art, Leeum Museum of Art, and Hongje Yuyeon, a public art space in the underground of Eugene Shopping Center along Hongjecheon Stream.

【CHAPTER 4 · 8 Hangang Parks & Urban Forest Healing】
Cycling, picnics, and water leisure unfold along the Hangang River, stretching from Yeouido, Banpo, Mangwon, Ichon, Jamwon, Ttukseom, and Jamsil Hangang Parks to Nodeul Island, a music complex cultural space. Top urban retreats include Seoul Forest, famous for its silver grass view at Wind Hill, World Cup Park, and Maeheon Citizens' Forest.

【CHAPTER 5 · Seoul's 5 Major Districts' Neighborhoods & Walkable Alleys】
The distinct characteristics of each district shine brightly: Central (Myeongdong, Euljiro, Namsan Oreumi, Dongdaemun), Central-North (Seochon Cafe Street, Bukchon Hanok Village with over 900 houses, Insadong, Daehangno), Northeast (Seongsu-shodak/Handmade Shoe Street, Cafe Street, Konkuk Univ. Common Ground), Northwest/Gangseo (Sangam, Hapjeong, Mangwon, Hongdae, Yeonnam, Mullae Creative Village, Hangdong Railroad), and Gangnam/Jamsil (Sinsa Garosu-gil, Apgujeong Rodeo, COEX Aquarium, Seokchon Lake).

【CHAPTER 6 · TASTY SEOUL Food Alleys, Old Shops & Seasonal Festivals】
Local soul foods like Noryangjin Fisheries Wholesale Market, Jangchung-dong Jokbal (Pig's Trotters) Alley, and Ojangdong Hamheung Naengmyeon Street are rich alongside long-established shops and vegan restaurants. Seasonally, the Yeouido Spring Flower Festival in April, Hangang Festival in July–August, and Seoul Street Arts Festival & Seoul World Fireworks Festival in September–October adorn all of Seoul.

paragraphs:
【CHAPTER 1 · ソウル5大古宮＆韓服無料入場ティップ】
朝鮮王朝500年の歴史が宿る景福宮・昌徳宮・昌慶宮（09:00~21:00）・徳寿宮・慶熙宮と宗廟は、ソウル旅行の第一関門です。韓服を着用して訪問すると5大古宮すべて無料入場が可能で、宮陵遺跡本部（royal.khs.go.kr）にて昌徳宮後苑・景福宮夜間観覧などの事前予約を行うことができます。

【CHAPTER 2 · 都心城郭道＆漢陽都城巡城ハイキング】
史跡地でありソウルの山稜をつなぐ漢陽都城巡城道は、体力に合わせて区間を選ぶことができます。なだらかな散策型の駱山区間（恵化門〜興仁之門、2.1km・約1時間）、南山公園とつながる南山区間（4.2km・約3時間）、山稜の眺望に優れた白岳区間（彰義門〜恵化門、4.7km・約3時間）が代表的です。

【CHAPTER 3 · 国立博物館＆文化芸術空間ベスト】
国宝・宝物を含む約43万点の遺物を所蔵する龍山国立中央博物館（水・土21:00夜間開場）と国立ハングル博物館、西大門刑務所歴史館が歴史コースの中心をなします。現代美術は国立現代美術館ソウル館・徳寿宮館、ソウル市立美術館、リウム美術館、弘済川ユジン商街地下の公共美術空間「弘済ユエン」へと続きます。

【CHAPTER 4 · 漢江公園8選＆都心の森ヒーリング】
汝矣島・盤浦・望ウォン・二村・蚕院・トゥクソム・蚕室漢江公園と音楽複合文化空間のノドゥル島まで、漢江沿いにサイクリング・ピクニック・ウォータースポーツが広がります。都心のオアシスとしては、風の丘のススキの眺めが絶品のソウル林、ワールドカップ公園、梅軒市民の森が挙げられます。

【CHAPTER 5 · ソウル5大権域の町＆歩いて楽しい路地裏】
中心街（明洞・乙支路・南山オルミ・東大門）、中部（西촌カフェ通り・北村韓屋村約900棟・仁寺洞・大学路）、東北部（聖水洞手製靴・カフェ通り・建大コモングラウンド）、西北・江西（上岩・合井・望ウォン・弘大・延南・文래創作村・杭洞鉄道）、江南・蚕室（新沙カロスキル・狎鴎亭ロデオ・COEXアクアリウム・石村湖）まで、権域ごとの個性が際立っています。

【CHAPTER 6 · TASTY SEOUL グルメ通り・老舗・季節のお祭り】
鷺梁津水産市場、長忠洞豚足通り、五壮洞咸興冷麺通りなどローカルソウルフードや老舗・ヴィーガンレストランが多彩です。季節ごとには、4月の汝矣島春の花祭り、7〜8月の漢江フェスティバル、9〜10月のソウル道路芸術祭・ソウル世界花火大会がソウル全域を彩ります。

zh.source_book: 首爾觀光財團 Visit Seoul《2026首爾觀光指南》網路版
zh.title: 《2026首爾觀光指南》網路版 — 5大區域、主題路線、美食、韓屋總整理
zh.subtitle: 首爾5大區域（市中心・中部・東北・西北・江南）50頁官方指南核心完全讀本
zh.address: 首爾特別市鐘路區社稷路161（景福宮・北村・南山・漢江區域）
zh.pull_quote: 12MB共50頁的《2026首爾觀光指南》，從古宮、漢陽都城、博物館、漢江、社區小巷、美食街、慶典到實用資訊，透過一篇網路雜誌即可一次掌握。
paragraphs:
【CHAPTER 1 · 首爾5大古宮與韓服免費入園攻略】
蘊含朝鮮王朝500年歷史的景福宮、昌德宮、昌慶宮（09:00~21:00）、德壽宮、慶熙宮與宗廟是首爾旅遊的第一門市。穿著韓服造訪即可免費進入所有5大古宮，亦可透過宮陵遺跡本部（royal.khs.go.kr）進行昌德宮後苑、景福宮夜間開放等預先登記。

【CHAPTER 2 · 市中心城郭路與漢陽都城健行】
漢陽都城順城路作為古蹟並串聯首爾山脊，可依體力挑選適合的路段。代表性路線包含平緩散步型的駱山路段（惠化門～興仁之門，2.1公里，約1小時）、與南山公園相連的南山路段（4.2公里，約3小時），以及視野極佳的白岳路段（彰義門～惠化門，4.7公里，約3小時）。

【CHAPTER 3 · 國立博物館與文化藝術空間精選】
典藏包含國寶與寶物在內約43萬件文物的龍山國立中央博物館（週三、週六夜間開放至21:00）、國立韓글博物館以及西大門刑務所歷史館構成了歷史路線的核心。現代藝術則延伸至國立現代美術館首爾館與德壽宮館、首爾市立美術館、Leeum美術館，以及位於弘濟川尤金商場地下的公共藝術空間「弘濟溪流（弘濟流淵）」。

【CHAPTER 4 · 漢江公園8選與市中心森林療癒】
沿著漢江岸邊，從汝矣島、盤浦、望遠、二村、蠶院、뚝섬（뚝섬/纛島）、蠶室漢江公園到音樂複合文化空間鷺得島，展開了單車騎乘、野餐與水上休閒活動。市中心的休憩勝地則首推以風之丘芒草美景聞名的首爾林、世界盃公園與梅軒市民之森。

【CHAPTER 5 · 首爾5大區域社區與好走的巷弄】
各區特色鮮明：市中心（明洞、乙州路、南山無障礙電梯、東大門）、中部（西村咖啡街、擁有約900棟建築的北村韓屋村、仁寺洞、大學路）、東北部（聖水洞手工鞋街、咖啡街、建大貨櫃商場Common Ground）、西北與江西（上岩、合井、望遠、弘大、延南、文來創作村、杭洞鐵道），以及江南與蠶室（新沙洞林蔭道、狎鷗亭羅德奧、COEX水族館、石촌湖水）。

【CHAPTER 6 · TASTY SEOUL 美食街、老店與季節慶典】
鷺梁津水產市場、獎충洞豬腳街、五壯洞咸興冷麵街等在地靈魂美食，以及老字號店家與素食餐廳種類豐富。季節方面，4月的汝矣島春花節、7至8月的漢江節、9至10月的首爾街頭藝術節與首爾世界煙火節，點綴了整個首爾。

paragraphs: Haenyeoui Jip is a seafood specialty restaurant located along the western coastal road of Aewol-eup, Jeju Island, where you can enjoy fresh seasonal seafood. Thanks to the exceptional freshness and quality of its ingredients, it draws a steady stream of visitors. Representative seafood includes abalone, turban shells, and rocky sea squirts, served in various raw or cooked preparations.

Among the cooked items, boiled octopus, steamed turban shells, and abalone porridge are especially popular. Abalone porridge is a favorite among visitors to Haenyeoui Jip, freshly cooked upon order so you can enjoy a warm and tender texture. Situated right along the western coastal road touching the sea, Haenyeoui Jip offers the great advantage of taking in beautiful Jeju ocean views while dining.

en.title: Noraba
en.overview: Noraba is a seafood ramen specialty restaurant located on a back road in Guom-ri, Aewol-eup, Jeju-si. Named after the Jeju dialect phrase meaning 'a seaside nook where you eat ramen while watching the sunset,' Noraba is a restaurant remodeled from a cozy Jeju stone house with both indoor and outdoor seating. Its signature menus are octopus ramen and sliced stone octopus. The octopus ramen features a whole crab and an entire abalone along with octopus.

paragraphs: Noraba is a seafood ramen specialty restaurant located on a back road in Guom-ri, Aewol-eup, Jeju-si. Named after the Jeju dialect phrase meaning 'a seaside nook where you eat ramen while watching the sunset,' Noraba is a restaurant remodeled from a cozy Jeju stone house with both indoor and outdoor seating. Its signature menus are octopus ramen and sliced stone octopus. The octopus ramen features a whole crab and an entire abalone along with octopus.

Because ingredients are limited, they close early when supplies run out. Other popular items include seafood ramen and the retro lunchbox, and you can also order sets combining ramen, the retro lunchbox, and boiled octopus slices. Mild, medium, and spicy flavors are available so children can enjoy it too. A nearby attraction worth visiting together is the Guom-ri Stone Salt Farm.

en.overview: Kkumnang Bapjib is a neat, refined Korean restaurant located in Aewol-eup, Jeju. Its signature menu is dried yellow corvina (bori-gulbi), served as a full table setting accompanied by piping hot stone pot rice and various side dishes. The dried corvina is not overly salty, allowing you to enjoy its savory flavor, which is doubled when eaten with the stone pot rice.
en.pull_quote: Signature Menu: Dried Yellow Corvina · Pork Scallion Bulgogi / Jumbo Prawn & Abalone Soy Sauce Pickle / King Rib Soup / etc.
paragraphs: Kkumnang Bapjib is a neat, refined Korean restaurant located in Aewol-eup, Jeju. Its signature menu is dried yellow corvina (bori-gulbi), served as a full table setting accompanied by piping hot stone pot rice and various side dishes. The dried corvina is not overly salty, allowing you to enjoy its savory flavor, which is doubled when eaten with the stone pot rice.

The cheonggukjang (fermented soybean paste stew) is popular among guests for its deep and rich flavor, and its nutty aroma and warm broth enhance dining satisfaction. In addition to dried yellow corvina, a wide selection of Korean dishes is available. Each menu item is thoughtfully prepared—such as the pork scallion bulgogi, savory soy-marinated rock crab, fresh jumbo prawns and abalones in soy sauce, and generous king rib soup—ensuring high satisfaction.

en.overview: Lala Cafe is an emotional and cozy cafe located in Gwangryeong-ri, Aewol-eup, Jeju-si, standing out for its open natural scenery and relaxed space. It features a spacious and beautiful garden with distant ocean views, offering visitors a special relaxation. In particular, it features a canola flower field, making it famous as a seasonal photo spot in spring when yellow canola flowers are in full bloom.

paragraphs: Lala Cafe is an emotional and cozy cafe located in Gwangryeong-ri, Aewol-eup, Jeju-si, standing out for its open natural scenery and relaxed space. It features a spacious and beautiful garden with distant ocean views, offering visitors a special relaxation. In particular, it features a canola flower field, making it famous as a seasonal photo spot in spring when yellow canola flowers are in full bloom.

With plenty of seating, visitors can comfortably stay whether alone or with family and friends. Aesthetic photo zones are set up throughout the cafe, and a wide variety of menu items are available. Alongside coffee and drinks, you can enjoy bingsu (shaved ice) and simple brunch menus, making it an attractive spot to enjoy meals and desserts together. Nearby is Hangpaduri Hangmong Historical Site, embodying Jeju's history and stories, making it a recommended travel course to visit before or after the cafe.

en.title: Anforet
en.overview: Anforet is a cafe located in Seobu-ri, Jain-myeon, Gyeongsan-si. Situated right next to Gaejeongsup Forest, it is a great spot to relax in nature. Its calm exterior and interior, combined with a meticulously maintained spacious garden, make it a comfortable destination for families, couples, and gatherings alike. Brunch menu items such as Brisket Jjamppong Pasta, Cheongyang Bulgogi Burger, and Cheongyang Corn Pizza are popular, and spice levels can be adjusted. The signature drink is Americano, and a variety of beverages including Anforet Latte and Affogato are also available.

paragraphs: Located near the Tongyeong Cable Car, the Donamhang East Breakwater Lighthouse was built to commemorate the various literary figures produced by Tongyeong and their achievements, and was first lit in December 1986. Featuring an innovative design with 12 outer columns and 6 inner columns rising vertically to a great height, the structure itself is a work of art selected through a design competition.

This lighthouse symbolizes the vibrant spirit of leaping toward the sky overcoming gravity and Tongyeong's literary achievements, meaning that this gathered energy emits a bright light to guide future generations on the right path. It flashes a green light once every 4 seconds, indicating safe routes for ships entering and leaving Donam Port. Near the east breakwater where the lighthouse stands, visitors can explore attractions such as Tongyeong Kumho Marina Resort, Tongyeong International Music Hall, and Donam Tourist District.

paragraphs: Motjae is a pond located on the summit of Jisan Mountain to the west of Naecheon-ri, Yulgok-myeon, Hapcheon-gun. While some say it is a crater lake formed by a volcanic explosion, it is presumed to have been created by natural subsidence. A plant called watershield (sunchae) grows naturally here. In the past, this plant was considered a miraculous remedy for leprosy, skin diseases, and jaundice, prompting many patients to visit in search of medicinal herbs to cure their illnesses. It is also said that nearby residents used to gather on the surrounding lawn to divide into teams and build camaraderie through folk wrestling (ssireum) matches.

Additionally, during the Imjin War, Japanese troops camped here and engaged in battle with our righteous army stationed at Baengmasanseong Fortress opposite. The surrounding Jisan Park, located just north of Cheonjimot Pond, is a community amenity featuring an octagonal pavilion, lawns, and shady trees where local residents enjoy picnics. Cheonjibong Peak, at the summit of Cheonjimot, offers breathtaking panoramic views in all directions, and on the first full moon of the lunar new year, residents burn large moon-welcoming fires (daljip) to pray for a bountiful harvest and peace. Known as Dalmaji-bong (Moon-gazing Peak), it is a naturally occurring resort deeply rooted in history and scenic beauty.

paragraphs: モッチジェは陜川郡栗谷面内川里の西側の芝山山頂にある池で、火山爆発によってできた火口湖とも言われていますが、自然陥没によってできたものと推定されています。ジュンサイという植物が自生しており、かつてはこの植物がハンセン病、皮膚病、黄疸などの特効薬と言われ、多くの患者が病気を治療する薬草を求めてやって来たといいます。また、周辺の芝生には近隣の住民が集まってチームに分かれ、民俗遊びであるシルム（韓国相撲）の試合で親睦を深めたそうです。

また、文禄・慶長の役（壬辰倭乱）の際には日本軍が陣を構え、向かい側の白馬山城に駐屯した我が国の義兵と接戦を繰り広げた場所でもあります。周辺の芝山公園は天地池のすぐ北側に位置する郡民の便宜施設で、八角亭があり、芝生や周辺の木陰が素晴らしく近隣住民がピクニックを楽しむ公園です。天地池の頂上にある天地峰は四方が一望できる絶景で、旧暦の小正月（大正月）には住民たちがタルジプ（月の家）を燃やしてその年の豊年と無病息災を祈願する、別名「月見峰」とも呼ばれる場所です。周囲の景観はもちろん、由来の深い自然発生的な遊園地です。

此外，在壬辰倭亂（朝鮮之役）時，日軍也曾在此扎營，與駐紮在對面白馬山城的我方義兵發生激戰。周邊的芝山公園是位於天地池正北方的郡民休閒設施，設有八角亭，草坪與周邊樹蔭環境優美，是附近居民野餐的好去處。天地池頂峰的天地峰視野遼闊，能將四方美景盡收眼底。農曆正月大望節時，居民們還會燃燒月宅火（焚燒月屋），祈求當年豐收與平安，又被稱為迎月峰。此處不僅自然風光秀麗，更是歷史淵源深厚的自然遊園地。

en.title: Sunny and Woodcutter (Seonnyewa Namukkun)
en.overview: Located in Seonheul-ri, Jocheon-eup, Jeju, Sunny and Woodcutter is an indoor theme park where visitors can take a nostalgic trip down memory lane. Stepping into a building designed to replicate the old Seoul Station, visitors are greeted with miniature buildings of various themes and displays of vintage items. Walking through scenes of old downtown areas, moon villages, retro dance halls, tea rooms, and comic book shops modeled after traditional marketplaces, older generations can reminisce while younger generations who haven't experienced those times can imagine the lives their parents once lived.

In the area recreating an old school, visitors of all ages love the special experience of wearing vintage school uniforms and taking commemorative photos. There are endless things to see, including a themed paper mulberry doll exhibition space and an agricultural museum displaying folk items like farming tools. You can also make special memories at an experience hall featuring traditional games like hoop rolling, top spinning, and jump rope, as well as a small animal zone with pheasants, rabbits, and chickens, and a spooky goblin house. en.title: Kumho Resort Jeju Aquana
en.overview: Kumho Resort Jeju Aquana is a water leisure facility located inside Kumho Resort Jeju near the Namwon Tourist Area. Its highlight is the stunning, unobstructed ocean view from the swimming pool framed by meadows and the beautiful coastal cliffs of the Jeju sea. It is equipped with various facilities including an indoor swimming pool, open-air event baths, outdoor swimming pools, outdoor slides, and a sauna. Following the walking trail connected to the resort leads to Namwon Gureong Beach, where you can enjoy scenery featuring bizarre rock cliffs and clear blue seas.

en.title: Seogwipo Marine Provincial Park
en.overview: This is a marine provincial park centered around the coast of Seogwipo-si, Jeju Special Self-Governing Province. Recognized as one of the 75 scenic views of Seogwipo, it is well-known as the quintessential Seogwipo coastal scenic spot, featuring coastal cliffs spanning about seventyri east and west around Seogwipo City harmonizing with islands floating on blue waves. Boasting beautiful scenery, it is the southern limit habitat for globally rare distylium trees (machilus thunbergii) and the natural monument black pigeon.
en.pull_quote: This is a marine provincial park centered around the coast of Seogwipo-si, Jeju Special Self-Governing Province. Recognized as one of the 75 scenic views of Seogwipo, it is well-known...
paragraphs: This is a marine provincial park centered around the coast of Seogwipo-si, Jeju Special Self-Governing Province. Recognized as one of the 75 scenic views of Seogwipo, it is well-known as the quintessential Seogwipo coastal scenic spot, featuring coastal cliffs spanning about seventyri east and west around Seogwipo City harmonizing with islands floating on blue waves. Boasting beautiful scenery, it is the southern limit habitat for globally rare distylium trees and the natural monument black pigeon.

It also represents the biodiversity of southern marine species as a site featuring prominent geological columnar joints and numerous new or unrecorded species of Korean endemic marine life with high academic value. To maintain ecological order through marine ecosystem resource conservation and create new tourism trends by maximizing resource utilization, Seogwipo Marine City Park was converted into Seogwipo Marine Provincial Park in January 2007. It is particularly well-known as a wonderful spot for sunrises and sunsets. Furthermore, located at the entrance of Cheonjeyeon Waterfall, the park serves as a relaxing station for those returning after fully absorbing the beauty of the waterfall.

paragraphs: 済州特別自治道西帰浦市の海岸を中心に形成された海洋道立公園だ。「西帰浦70景」の一つであるここは、西帰浦市を中心に東西に約七十里にわたる海岸絶壁と、青い波の上に浮かぶ島々が調和した美しい美港として、西帰浦観光の真髄としてよく知られた西帰浦海岸七十里景勝地である。景色が美しく、世界的にも珍しいタブノキが自生しており、天然記念物であるカラスバトが生息する南限地域である。

また、地質構造上の特徴である柱状節理や、学術的価値の高い韓国特産の海産生物の新種・未記録種が多数出現する場所として、南方系生物種の多様性を代表している。海洋生態資源の保存を通じて生態的秩序を維持し、資源活用の極大化により新しい観光形態を創出するため、2007年1月に「西帰浦海洋市立公園」から「西帰浦海洋道立公園」に変更された。特に、日の出と日の入りが美しい場所としてよく知られている。さらに、公園は天地淵（チョンジヨン）瀑布の入り口にあり、瀑布の美しさにすっかり魅了されて戻ってきた人たちにとって、旅の途中の駅のような役割を果たしている。

zh.title: 西歸浦海洋道立公園
zh.addr: 濟州特別自治道西歸浦市南城中路43（西弘洞）
zh.overview: 這是以濟州特別自治道西歸浦市海岸為中心所組成的海洋道立公園。作為「西歸浦70景」之一，這裡以西歸浦市為中心，東西綿延約七十里，環繞著海岸懸崖，與蔚藍波濤上的島嶼交織成絕美的天然良港，是聞名遐邇的西歸浦觀光精華——西歸浦海岸七十里景勝地。這裡景致優美，生長著世界稀有品種的紅楠（Machilus thunbergii），也是天然紀念物黑鴿子棲息的南部極限地區。

en.title: Hado-ri Migratory Bird Habitat
en.overview: Located in Hado-ri, Gujwa-eup, Jeju-si, this migratory bird habitat is adjacent to the sea and boasts abundant nutrient-rich prey and wetland plants, making it an optimal region for migratory birds to spend the winter. Designated as a natural monument, the area welcomes about 30 species of migratory birds every year, including the black-faced spoonbill—of which only about 1,600 remain worldwide—as well as natural monuments like swans, falcons, and kestrels, and the Ministry of Environment's endangered wild animal, the osprey.
en.pull_quote: Located in Hado-ri, Gujwa-eup, Jeju-si, this migratory bird habitat is adjacent to the sea and boasts abundant nutrient-rich prey and wetland plants, making it an optimal region for migratory birds...
paragraphs: Located in Hado-ri, Gujwa-eup, Jeju-si, this migratory bird habitat is adjacent to the sea and boasts abundant nutrient-rich prey and wetland plants, making it an optimal region for migratory birds to spend the winter. Designated as a natural monument, the area welcomes about 30 species of migratory birds every year, including the black-faced spoonbill—of which only about 1,600 remain worldwide—as well as natural monuments like swans, falcons, and kestrels, and the Ministry of Environment's endangered wild animal, the osprey.

At the foot of Jimibong Peak in Hado-ri, an estuary dam was constructed along the coast to create a reservoir, providing abundant food and numerous nesting sites. Visitors can observe the migratory birds through telescopes installed at the bird-watching pavilion. In particular, the scenery of the bridge built during the dam construction is exceptional, making it a notable driving course.

en.overview: Dochidol Hanwoo Charcoal Grill is a Korean beef specialty restaurant located in Nabeup-ri, the mid-mountain region of Jeju, loved by many for its fresh ingredients and pleasant environment. The name 'Dochidol' originates from a rock in the middle of a stream flowing between Nabeup-ri and Eoeum-ri, which is shaped like the blade of a triangular axe. Dochidol Hanwoo Charcoal Grill uses only fresh Korean beef slaughtered on the same day.

paragraphs: Dochidol Hanwoo Charcoal Grill is a Korean beef specialty restaurant located in Nabeup-ri, the mid-mountain region of Jeju, loved by many for its fresh ingredients and pleasant environment. The name 'Dochidol' originates from a rock in the middle of a stream flowing between Nabeup-ri and Eoeum-ri, which is shaped like the blade of a triangular axe. Dochidol Hanwoo Charcoal Grill uses only fresh Korean beef slaughtered on the same day.

Menu items include galbitang (beef short rib soup) with a clean broth, hanwoo sirloin, and yukhoe (raw beef) where freshness is crucial. The restaurant interior is spacious and clean, making it suitable for family meals or group gatherings, allowing guests to enjoy their meal in a comfortable and pleasant atmosphere. Furthermore, after being featured on variety shows, it has established itself as a must-visit restaurant sought after by even more tourists. After your meal, we recommend checking out the nearby Dochidol Alpaca Ranch.

en.title: Kim Marie
en.overview: Kim Marie is a snack restaurant located on a street corner in front of Seonghwan Apartment across from Jeju City Hall. Initially known as a hidden local favorite mainly among residents, it has gradually gained word-of-mouth popularity among Jeju travelers. Its signature menu is 'Kim Marie Yubu Gimbap (fried tofu gimbap)', boasting an original taste differentiated from regular gimbap.
en.pull_quote: Signature Delicacies: Kim Marie Fried Tofu Gimbap · Marie Special / Tuna Fried Tofu Gimbap / Salad Fried Tofu Gimbap, etc.
paragraphs: Kim Marie is a snack restaurant located on a street corner in front of Seonghwan Apartment across from Jeju City Hall. Initially known as a hidden local favorite mainly among residents, it has gradually gained word-of-mouth popularity among Jeju travelers. Its signature menu is 'Kim Marie Yubu Gimbap', boasting an original taste differentiated from regular gimbap.

This gimbap is made with fillings prepared by adding lemon syrup made directly from organic lemons and Jeju mandarins, and carefully stir-frying fried tofu at low temperatures for over an hour. Another popular menu item, 'Marie Special', is a mixed tteokbokki packed with generous toppings such as crispy fried food, dumplings, boiled eggs, and ramen noodles. Topped with an abundance of melted cheese, it boasts a rich flavor and addictive taste. It's a great spot to drop by during your Jeju trip for a casual and satisfying meal.

paragraphs: キムマリは、済州市役所の向かいにあるソンファンアパートの前、路地裏の角に位置する粉食専門店だ。当初は地元住民を中心とした隠れた名店として知られていたが、徐々に口コミで広がり、済州の旅行者にも知られるようになった。代表メニューは「キムマリユブキンパ」で、一般的な海苔巻きとは一味違う独創的な味わいを誇る。

この海苔巻きは、有機農レモンで直接作ったレモンジャムと済州産ミカンを入れ、油揚げを1時間以上低温で丁寧に炒めて作った具材で作られている。もう一つの人気メニューである「マリスペシャル」は盛り合わせトッポッキで、サクサクに揚げた天ぷら、マンドゥ（餃子）、ゆで卵、ラーメンサリなど多様なトッピングがたっぷり入っており、ボリューム満点で楽しめる。さらにチーズがたっぷりとのせられ、濃厚な風味とクセになる味わいが自慢だ。気軽に一食を済ませることができ、済州旅行中に立ち寄るのにぴったりだ。

這款紫菜包飯是以有機檸檬親自熬製的檸檬果醬與濟州產柑橘加入內餡，並將炸豆皮以低溫用心拌炒一小時以上所製作而成的內餡包裹而成。另一項人氣菜單「麻麗特餐」是綜合辣炒年糕，裡頭豪邁地加入了酥脆炸物、水餃、水煮蛋、泡麵等豐富配料，份量十足。上頭再鋪上滿滿的起司，散發濃郁香氣與讓人上癮的美味。由於能輕鬆解決一餐，非常適合在濟州旅遊途中順道造訪。

en.pull_quote: Jageun Guhakpo is a key dinosaur footprint fossil site near Danghangpo. While the larger Guhakpo also features large herbivore footprints, its entrance is currently under construction and dangerous...
paragraphs: Jageun Guhakpo is a representative dinosaur footprint fossil site located in the same zone as Danghangpo. While large herbivore footprints can also be seen at the larger Guhakpo, the entrance is currently under construction and hazardous, making Jageun Guhakpo the recommended alternative for this course. The only drawback is that it can be a bit tricky to find, but once located, searching for dinosaur footprints on the coastal rocks is a delightful experience.

Turn into Jangjwa-ri from National Route 77 and look for the Guhakpo Dinosaur Footprint Fossil Site sign. Park temporarily and walk down the mountain path to reach the fossil site. Though not extremely clear, the recognizable footprints prove that dinosaurs once lived here. While less famous than Sangjokam or Danghangpo, the dinosaur footprints and the scenic walking trail leading to them offer great charm. Note: Check the tide times carefully to properly view the dinosaur footprints here.

77番国道から東海面長佐里に入り、「クハク浦恐竜足跡化石地」の案内看板が見えればまずは成功だ。簡易駐車場に車を止め、山道を下ると恐竜足跡化石地にたどり着く。それほど鮮明ではないが、識別できる恐竜の足跡が、かつてここに恐竜たちが暮らしていたことを証明している。上足岩（サンジョカム）や唐項浦ほど有名ではないが、恐竜の足跡はもちろん、足跡へと続く山道も歩く楽しさがある。ただし、ここで恐竜の足跡をしっかり見るためには潮の満ち引きをよく合わせる必要がある。

從77號國道轉入東海面長佐里，看到「九鶴浦恐龍足跡化石遺址」的指示牌就代表成功了一半。將車輛簡易停放後，沿著山路往下走便能抵達恐龍足跡化石地。雖然足跡不算十分清晰，但仍能辨認，證明了恐龍曾在此生活過。雖然知名度不如上足岩或唐項浦，但除了恐龍足跡本身外，通往化石地的沿途山路也充滿了健行的樂趣。不過，要在這裡清晰地觀賞恐龍足跡，必須抓準退潮時間。

en.title: Oepo Port, Geoje
en.overview: Designated as a national fishing port in December 1971 and currently managed by the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, Oepo Port spans 0.8 km in width with an inner harbor depth of 8m and outer harbor depth of 22m. As the nation's premier Pacific cod distribution center—accounting for over 30% of the country's cod supply—the port comes alive every day at 10 AM with the booming voices of auctioneers at the Oepo-ri fish market. Packed with fresh cod, it is a wonderful place to enjoy invigorating cod soup.

en.title: Hwangsan Village Traditional Stone-Mud Walls, Geochang
en.overview: The ancient stone-mud walls of Hwangsan Village in Geochang enclose traditional houses belonging to the Geochang Sin clan lineage. The village preserves houses built from the late Joseon Dynasty to the modern era, offering a glimpse of a traditional Korean settlement. Large natural stones are stacked at the base without mortar to ensure good drainage, topped with alternating layers of small stones and clay. Most walls are capped with traditional Korean tile roofing (hansik giwa). The gently curving walls harmonize with historic houses to create a serene landscape.

en.title: Mireukdo Island, Tongyeong
en.overview: Mireukdo is an island south of Tongyeong connected to the mainland by two bridges and an undersea tunnel. Its highlight is the Sanyang Coastal Circular Road, famous for offering the ultimate Hallyudo marine scenery with beautiful coastal curves, hills, and quiet fishing ports. Donam-dong, the starting point of the circular road, features marina resorts and cruise terminals heading to nearby Hansando, Bijindo, Maemuldo, and Geoje Haegeumgang. Further south, Dala Park features benches and pavilions for viewing breathtaking sunsets over the southern sea. Yonghwasan Mountain in the center houses Yonghwasa and Miraesa temples, and walking the quiet forest trail between them is a must-do experience.
en.pull_quote: Mireukdo is an island south of Tongyeong connected to the mainland via bridges and an undersea tunnel. Its coastal circular road offers gorgeous sea curves...
paragraphs: Mireukdo is an island south of Tongyeong connected to the mainland by two bridges and an undersea tunnel. Mireukdo's coastal highlight, the Sanyang Circular Road, is famous for offering breathtaking views of the Hallyu archipelago, featuring stunning coastline curves, hills, and tranquil harbor scenery.

Donam-dong, the starting point, features marina resorts for water sports and cruise terminals offering trips to nearby Hansando, Bijindo, Maemuldo, and Geoje Haegeumgang, along with lodging and amenities. Dala Park on the south side of the road offers benches, resting areas, and a pavilion to enjoy dazzling sunset views over the South Sea. Meanwhile, Yonghwasan Mountain in the center features Yonghwasa Temple to the north and Miraesa Temple to the south; walking the tranquil hiking trail connecting both temples is a true highlight of Mireukdo tourism.

ja.title: 弥勒島

zh.addr: 慶尚南道統營市山陽邑南平里
zh.overview: 彌勒島是位於統營市南側的島嶼，透過兩座橋樑與一條海底隧道與陸地相連。作為彌勒島旅遊精華的海岸公路「山陽環島公路」以優美的海岸曲線、山丘與恬靜的漁港風情聞名，能讓旅客盡情感受閑麗水道的海濱風情。環島公路起點道南洞設有度假村等海洋休閒設施，並備有前往鄰近閑山島、飛津島、梅物島、巨濟海金剛等的遊輪碼頭、附屬設施及住宿設施。位於公路南側的達牙公園設有長椅、休息區與涼亭，是欣賞南海迷人夕陽的絕佳去處。另一方面，位於彌勒島正中央的龍華山南北分別建有龍華寺與未來寺，漫步於兩寺之間清幽的登山步道也是遊覽彌勒島的一大樂趣。

en.title: Mireukdo Tourist Zone, Tongyeong
en.overview: Mireukdo is an island within Hallyeohaesang National Park, serving as a hub for South Sea marine tourism and connected to the mainland via Chungmugyo Bridge. Designated as a special tourist zone, it offers diverse leisure opportunities. A major landmark is Mireuksan Mountain, rising in the center of the island. Visitors can take the Hallyudo Viewing Cable Car completed in 2008 to the summit for panoramic views of the archipelago. Though not exceptionally tall, Mireuksan is celebrated for its lush forests and clear streams, showcasing royal azaleas in spring and brilliant foliage in autumn.
en.pull_quote: Mireukdo is an island in Hallyeohaesang National Park and a marine tourism hub connected by Chungmugyo Bridge. Designated as a special tourist zone...
paragraphs: Mireukdo is an island within Hallyeohaesang National Park, serving as a hub for South Sea marine tourism and connected to the mainland via Chungmugyo Bridge. Designated as a special tourist zone, it offers diverse leisure opportunities. A major landmark is Mireuksan Mountain, rising in the center of the island. Visitors can take the Hallyudo Viewing Cable Car completed in 2008 to the summit for panoramic views of the archipelago. Though not exceptionally tall, Mireuksan is celebrated for its lush forests and clear streams, showcasing royal azaleas in spring and brilliant foliage in autumn.

Well-maintained hiking trails allow for a light two-hour hike. A popular course starts from Yonghwasa Square, passes Gwaneamsa Temple and Mireukjae to reach the summit, and descends via Miraesa Temple and Ttibat back to Yonghwasa Square. Living up to its reputation, marine tourism is highly developed here, offering yachting, cruises, windsurfing, kayaking, and water skiing. Cruise ferries connecting to Hansando, Bijindo, and Maemuldo in Tongyeong's coastal waters are popular leisure activities for all ages. Additionally, the Musical Fountain Rest Plaza offers sweet melodies and colorful laser shows.

ja.title: 弥勒島観光特区

這裡的登山步道規劃完善，進行約2小時的輕鬆登山也非常合適。經典路線為從龍華寺廣場出發，經觀音寺與彌勒齋登上山頂，隨後經未來寺與띠밭（草地）下山返回龍華寺廣場。正如其名，此處的海洋旅遊業相當發達，可體驗遊艇、遊輪、風帆衝浪、獨木舟、水上摩托車等多樣化的水上運動。往返於統營外海閑山島、飛津島、梅物島等地的遊輪是老少咸宜的水上休閒活動。此外，音樂噴泉休息廣場還會上演動人音樂與色彩繽紛的雷射光影秀。

Climbing up Wolamdae offers a close view of the moon; historically known for its abundant rocks and scenic beauty, it was a place where people gazed at the moon and made wishes.

Visitors can enjoy a variety of menus including Geoje's local specialties such as sea squirt bibimbap, spicy raw fish soup (mulhoe), sea urchin bibimbap, abalone stone pot rice, and spicy fish stew.

Renowned among Geoje locals as a famous mulhoe hotspot with lines forming starting from lunchtime. The mulhoe is hearty, featuring fresh seafood served with noodles and rice. Located near Sono Calm Geoje, it offers convenient access to famous attractions like Windy Hill, Hakdong Mongdol Beach, and Haegeumgang, making it an ideal dining stop during travels.

en.title: Gyeongju Inwang-dong Temple Site
en.overview: The Inwang-dong Temple Site in Gyeongju is believed to be the former location of Inyongsa Temple. Mentioned in the 'Samguk Yusa' (Memorabilia of the Three Kingdoms), Inyongsa was built to pray for the well-being of Kim In-mun (629–694), the second son of King Muyeol of Silla. According to historical records, after Goguryeo fell, Tang China attempted to conquer Silla and imprisoned Kim In-mun, who was staying in Tang. The people of Silla opened a Avalokitesvara ritual to pray for his return, but when Kim In-mun died in 694 (the 3rd year of King Hyoso's reign) on his way back home, the ritual was converted into an Amitabha sanctuary to pray for his rebirth in the Pure Land. Inyongsa is the first recorded temple in Silla built for a private individual rather than a monk or royal family member, reflecting the religious practices of the time. Excavations were conducted four times between 2002 and 2011 by the National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage. It features a typical Silla twin-pagoda temple layout, alongside a rare '亞' (A-shaped) building site, pagoda sites, a main hall site, lecture hall site, corridor site, lotus pond, and a well.
en.pull_quote: The Gyeongju Inwang-dong Temple Site is presumed to be the location of Inyongsa Temple. Mentioned in the 'Samguk Yusa', Inyongsa was built to pray for the well-being of Kim In-mun (629-694)...
paragraphs: The Gyeongju Inwang-dong Temple Site in Gyeongju is believed to be the site of Inyongsa Temple. Featured in the 'Samguk Yusa', Inyongsa was a temple built to pray for the well-being of Kim In-mun (629–694), the second son of King Muyeol. According to records, after the fall of Goguryeo, Tang China attempted to conquer Silla and imprisoned Kim In-mun, who was staying in Tang.

The people of Silla held a Gwaneum (Avalokitesvara) ritual praying for his return, but when Kim In-mun died in 694 (the 3rd year of King Hyoso's reign) while returning home, they changed it to a Mita (Amitabha) ritual to pray for his peaceful afterlife. Inyongsa is the first temple in Silla built for a private individual rather than a monk or a monarch, showing the form of faith at the time. Excavations were carried out in four phases from 2002 to 2011 by the National Gyeongju Research Institute of Cultural Heritage. Featuring a typical Silla twin-pagoda layout, a rare '亞'-shaped building site, pagoda sites, main hall site, lecture hall site, corridor site, lotus pond, and well have been identified.

ja.overview: 慶州仁王洞寺跡は、仁用寺（イニョンサ）の跡地と推定されています。『三国遺事』に登場する仁用寺は、太宗武烈王の次男である金仁問（629〜694）の安寧を祈る寺です。記録によると、高句麗滅亡後、唐は新ラまで征服しようと企て、唐に滞在していた金仁問を投獄しました。新ラの人々は彼の帰国を祈願して観音道場を開きましたが、孝ソ王3年（694）に金仁問が帰国の途中で亡くなると、その極楽浄土を祈る弥陀道場に変更しました。仁用寺は新ラにおいて、僧侶や王ではなく個人のために建てられた最初の寺院であり、当時の信仰の形態を示しています。2002年から2011年まで国立慶州文化財研究所が4回にわたり発掘調査を行いました。新ラの典型的な双塔式伽藍配置であり、類例の少ない「亞」字形の建物跡をはじめ、塔跡、金堂跡、講堂跡、回廊跡、蓮池や井戸などが確認されました。

en.title: Sangju Heossi Silk Fabric
en.overview: Heossi Silk is carrying on the 5th generation of traditional silk weaving from silkworm cocoons, one of the key specialties of Sangju, a region famously known for its 'three whites' (rice, silk, and dried persimmons). The workshop relocated to its current site in 2002, actively opening its spacious 3,000-pyeong grounds to operate a reservation-only silk weaving experience center. By utilizing discarded antique spinning wheels and looms for exhibition and hands-on experiences, the center hosts events that share the past, present, and future of the traditional silk industry.

en.title: Munjangdae Peak
en.overview: Located on the border of Gyeongsangbuk-do and Chungcheongbuk-do, Mt. Soknisan features its main peak, Cheonhwangbong, in Sangori, Hwabuk-myeon, Sangju, while the breathtaking Munjangdae Peak is situated in Jangam-ri, Hwabuk-myeon. Generally, the front Sangju side of Mt. Soknisan is a treasure trove of natural scenic wonders, boasting magnificent peaks such as Cheonhwangbong, Ipseokdae, Sinseondae, Munjangdae, Gwaneumbong, Hyeongjebong, Dojangsan, Cheonghwasan, Gangseondae, and Samobong, alongside picturesque waterfalls like Osong and Janggak. Meanwhile, the rear Chungbuk side preserves national treasures and treasures within temples such as Beopjusa, Bokcheonam, Jungsajaam, Sanghwanam, and Sanggoam, creating a harmonious blend of nature and human architecture.
en.pull_quote: Situated on the border of Gyeongsangbuk-do and Chungcheongbuk-do, Mt. Soknisan's main peak Cheonhwangbong is in Sang-ori, Hwabuk-myeon, Sangju, while the scenic Munjangdae is in Jangam-ri...
paragraphs: Mt. Soknisan, located on the border between Gyeongsangbuk-do and Chungcheongbuk-do, has its main peak, Cheonhwangbong, in Sang-ori, Hwabuk-myeon, Sangju-si, and the picturesque Munjangdae Peak in Jangam-ri, Hwabuk-myeon. In general, the front Sangju area of Mt. Soknisan is a treasure trove of naturally formed scenic spots, featuring peaks like Cheonhwangbong, Ipseokdae, Sinseondae, Munjangdae, Gwaneumbong, Hyeongjebong, Dojangsan, Cheonghwasan, Gangseondae, and Samobong, and waterfalls such as Osong and Janggak. In contrast, the rear Chungbuk area features national treasures and treasures preserved in temples like Beopjusa, Bokcheonam, Jungsajaam, Sanghwanam, and Sanggoam, achieving a balance between nature and artifice.

en.title: Gyeongju Milmyeon Main Branch
en.overview: Milmyeon (wheat noodles) is a dish created by North Korean refugees who evacuated to Busan during the Korean War. The Gyeongju Milmyeon Main Branch inherited this noodle-making technique to faithfully recreate the authentic taste of traditional milmyeon. The noodles are freshly kneaded and pulled upon ordering, served in a broth simmered for 24 hours with Korean beef bones, medicinal herbs, and various vegetables. A standout feature here is that ordering milmyeon comes with charcoal-grilled iron-griddle bulgogi. Other menu items include spicy seasoned Bibim Milmyeon, handmade dumplings, and a whole plate of iron-griddle bulgogi.
en.pull_quote: Signature dishes: Milmyeon + Charcoal-grilled Bulgogi · Bibim Milmyeon + Charcoal-grilled Bulgogi / Iron-griddle Bulgogi Platter / Handmade Dumplings, etc.
paragraphs: Milmyeon was created by North Korean refugees who fled to Busan during the Korean War. The Gyeongju Milmyeon Main Branch inherited this noodle-making technique and recreates the genuine taste of traditional milmyeon.

Noodles are freshly hand-kneaded and pulled to order, served in a broth simmered in-house for 24 hours with Korean beef bone, herbal medicine, and assorted vegetables. A special feature of this place is that ordering milmyeon includes charcoal-grilled iron-griddle bulgogi. Other options include Bibim Milmyeon topped with spicy sauce, handmade dumplings, and an iron-griddle bulgogi platter.

en.title: Baekrihyang Hwangseong Main Branch
en.overview: Baekrihyang Hwangseong Main Branch is located in Hwangseong-dong, Gyeongju-si, Gyeongsangbuk-do. Its modern exterior and clean interior immediately catch the eye. Turning into the narrow lane leads unexpectedly to a large building and a spacious parking lot. The interior features group seating, making it ideal for various gatherings. paragraphs: Located along the coast of Chilcheondo Island in Geoje, Sohyang Dawon is a healing space where you can enjoy a healthy meal and a leisurely cup of tea. Stepping inside, you'll feel like you've entered a traditional teahouse, with loess walls, wooden tables, and tea-related exhibits placed throughout. Savory and warm buckwheat tea is served before the meal, followed by a neat spread of over 12 side dishes. There are two main meal options: lotus leaf rice and steamed lotus leaf sulfur-fed smoked duck.

The natural foods filling the table, along with the chewy and glutinous lotus leaf rice and tender, succulent smoked duck steam, stimulate both the eyes and the nose. Various teas, coffee, and craft beer are also available. If you want to sit by the window with an open view of the sea in front of Chilcheondo Island, making a reservation in advance is recommended. Nearby attractions include Okgye Beach, Chilcheonryang Naval Battle Park, and Geoje Maengjong Bamboo Theme Park.

paragraphs: Located near Sacheon Airport in Sacheon-si, Seoul Seolleongtang is a popular restaurant specializing in seolleongtang (ox bone soup) and galbi (short ribs). They offer a variety of menus, ranging from lunch staples like seolleongtang, beef bone galbitang (short rib soup), and doganitang (tendon soup) to hearty meat dishes. Their king charcoal-grilled pork features large, aged pork pieces that, when eaten with various vegetables in one bite, let you simultaneously experience the savory flavor of the meat and the freshness of the vegetables.

The prime beef king galbi is seasoned and aged with their unique recipe, allowing you to fully enjoy the rich juices and authentic taste of beef. There are regular tables in the center of the interior, group rooms on the left, and floor-seating tables on the right, so you can choose a comfortable spot. With its clean, spacious interior and private rooms, it is perfectly suited for group gatherings, family meals, and company dinners.

en.pull_quote: Signature Specialties: Seafood-Packed Kalguksu · Ye-Ije Special / Couple Set / Gejang Baekban, etc.
paragraphs: Located at Gujora Port in Geoje-si, Gyeongnam, Ye-Ije Seafood-Packed Kalguksu & Gejang is famous for its marinated crab set, but locals also highly recommend it as a place to taste refreshing kalguksu (knife-cut noodles) and sujebi (hand-pulled dough soup) loaded with seafood. All seafood used is freshly harvested directly by Geoje's haenyeo (female divers), and the side dishes are also made with homegrown vegetables. There is a couple's set including kalguksu and gejang, as well as a special menu where you can taste Geoje specialties all at once, including kalguksu, gejang, soy sauce-marinated shrimp, and clam seaweed soup.

Because it attracts many group tourists, visiting outside of peak hours is recommended if you want a more relaxed dining experience. It has good accessibility to Geoje's major tourist attractions, and Geoje Hanwha Resort Belvedere and Sono Calm Geoje are also located close by.

paragraphs: 位於慶南巨濟市構造拉港的「藝而得海鮮滿滿刀削麵與醬蟹」不僅以醬蟹定食聞名，在巨濟當地人之間，更是品嚐料多味美、湯頭清爽的刀削麵與片片麵的極佳去處。店內使用的所有海鮮均由巨濟島海女親自採捕，新鮮度極高，小菜也皆採用自家種植的蔬菜製作。這裡有包含刀削麵與醬蟹的情侶套餐，以及能一次品嚐刀削麵、醬蟹、醬油蝦、蛤蜊海帶湯等巨濟名物的特餐可以選擇。

en.title: Beotgul Sikdang
en.overview: Located in Gojeon-myeon, Hadong-gun, Beotgul Sikdang is open only during the peak season for beotgul (cherry oysters) from February to the end of April, when they taste the best. Therefore, it is recommended to call and check before visiting. Beotgul are not oysters that grow in the salty sea, but rather oysters that grow where freshwater and seawater meet. Because of this, they are not salty, have a sweet taste, and grow to be about five times the size of regular oysters. Their signature dishes are grilled beotgul and steamed beotgul, along with beotgul pancake...
en.pull_quote: Signature Specialties: Grilled Beotgul · Steamed Beotgul / Beotgul Porridge / Beotgul Pancake, etc.
paragraphs: Located in Gojeon-myeon, Hadong-gun, Beotgul Sikdang is open only during the peak season for beotgul (cherry oysters) from February to the end of April, when they taste the best. Therefore, it is recommended to call and check before visiting. Beotgul are not oysters that grow in the salty sea, but rather oysters that grow where freshwater and seawater meet. Because of this, they are not salty, have a sweet taste, and grow to be about five times the size of regular oysters.

Their signature menus are grilled beotgul and steamed beotgul, and they also sell beotgul pancakes, seasoned freshwater clam salad, and freshwater clam soup. Their homemade plum makgeolli (rice wine), made by adding homemade plum extract to makgeolli brought from a nearby brewery, pairs wonderfully with the food. Beotgul are shucked right next to you before serving, making them easy to eat. Grilling them in a charcoal kiln with their shells on and pairing them with red chili paste (chogochujang) or aged kimchi delivers an exceptional taste.

en.pull_quote: Signature Specialties: Grilled Fish · Grilled Fish / Life Mulhoe (Raw Fish Soup) / Sea Squirt Bibimbap / Raw Fish Rice Bowl, etc.
paragraphs: Located near Gujora Port in Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, Gujora Guijoara is a premium grilled fish specialty restaurant. While the signature grilled fish menu usually requires a minimum order of 2 servings, solo diners can order for 1 person. They source thick and fresh fish directly from local origins, offering a taste that sets them apart from ordinary grilled fish. You cannot choose individual fish types; instead, a combination of four kinds—mackerel, flounder, red rockfish, and fine-scaled drum—is served together. The side dishes are homemade and boast a clean, savory taste without being overly stimulating.

In addition, they offer their signature 'Life Mulhoe' infused with Gujora Guijoara's culinary know-how, as well as raw fish rice bowls, sea squirt bibimbap, and children's rice balls. Located on the 2nd floor of the building, you can enjoy your meal with an ocean view in a clean interior. Since the Gujora Cruise Passenger Terminal is right in front, it's a great spot to visit before your trip. Many tourists visit by recommendation due to its proximity to Sono Calm Geoje.

zh.addr: 慶尚南道巨濟市構造라路44-1
zh.overview: 位於慶尚南道巨濟市構造拉港附近的「構造拉烤得好啊」是一家高級烤魚專賣店。代表菜單烤魚雖然需從2人份起點，但若是獨自前來的遊客也可以點1人份。店家嚴選個頭大且新鮮的產地魚貨，擁有與一般常見烤魚截然不同的美味。魚類品種無法自行挑選，鯖魚、比目魚、長吻石斑（赤鯮）、黃姑魚四種會一同上桌。小菜皆為手作，不走刺激路線，呈現出清淡且精緻的口感。

paragraphs: 位於慶尚南道巨濟市構造拉港附近的「構造拉烤得好啊」是一家高級烤魚專賣店。代表菜單烤魚雖然需從2人份起點，但若是獨自前來的遊客也可以點1人份。店家嚴選個頭大且新鮮的產地魚貨，擁有與一般常見烤魚截然不同的美味。魚類品種無法自行挑選，鯖魚、比目魚、長吻石斑、黃姑魚四種會一同上桌。小菜皆為手作，不走刺激路線，呈現出清淡且精緻的口感。
除此之外，這裡還販售融入構造拉烤得好啊獨門祕訣的「人生涼拌生魚片」（Mulhoe），以及生魚片蓋飯、海鞘拌飯和專為兒童準備的小飯糰。餐廳位於建築物2樓，環境乾淨整潔，可以一邊欣賞海景一邊享用美食。由於構造拉遊覧船客運站就在正前方，非常適合在行程開始前造訪。因為靠近巨濟索諾캄度假村，許多遊客都是經人推薦而來。

en.overview: This is one of the walking trail courses where you can enjoy works of art imbued with the breath of artists alongside Jeju's beautiful ocean scenery. en.pull_quote: Local Recommended Partner · Connected Course with Nearby Restaurants & Safe Accommodations
paragraphs: This is one of the walking trail courses where you can enjoy works of art imbued with the breath of artists alongside Jeju's beautiful ocean scenery. Located where Jeju's freshwater and seawater meet, the observatory offers views of Seopseom Island straight ahead, Seogwipo Port to the right, and Munseom Island. After sunset, various lights illuminate the park, allowing you to fully experience Jeju even at night.

Named 'Jaguri,' meaning a place united by culture and art, various artworks and sculptures are exhibited throughout the park. At the end of the park, there is a freshwater bathing pool, making it a great place to briefly dip your feet and play. It is a transit point on Seogwipo's cultural and artistic trekking course, 'The Artist's Walk,' connecting Seogwipo's cultural and art spaces such as the Lee Jung-seop Museum and Soam Memorial Hall. It is said that the painter Lee Jung-seop spent his happiest times catching crabs with his wife and two sons on the Jaguri coast, where Seopseom and Munseom Islands are visible.

en.title: Hagosudong Beach
en.overview: Located in the sea northeast of Seongsanpo at the eastern tip of Jeju Island, Hagosudong Beach on the volcanic island of Udo is divided into two sections by a rocky coastline exposed in the center. The total length of the beach is about 400m, with basalt reefs exposed around 100m and 200m–300m to the east, and dune layers developed in the background. The beach was formed by the accumulation of materials transported by coastal currents. Until the 1970s, anchovy fishing using traditional 'huritgeum' (haul nets) took place here.
en.pull_quote: Local Recommended Partner · Connected Course with Nearby Restaurants & Safe Accommodations
paragraphs: Located in the sea northeast of Seongsanpo at the eastern tip of Jeju Island, Hagosudong Beach on the volcanic island of Udo is divided into two sections by a rocky coastline exposed in the center. The total length of the beach is about 400m, with basalt reefs exposed around 100m and 200m–300m to the east, and dune layers developed in the background. The beach was formed by the accumulation of materials transported by coastal currents. Until the 1970s, anchovy fishing using traditional 'huritgeum' (haul nets) took place here.

With its soft sand and shallow water, it is great for family vacationers with children. There are guesthouses and restaurants around the beach, along with convenience facilities such as changing rooms and restrooms. A haenyeo (female diver) statue modeled after a 70-year-old diver stands in the center, catching the eye. On summer nights, the lights lit by fishing boats shine brightly.

ja.title: 下水洞（ハゴスドン）ビーチ
ja.region_label: 済州 済州市 牛島面
ja.addr: 済州特別自治道済州市牛島面延平里
ja.overview: 済州島の東端・城山浦（ソンサンポ）の北東海上にある火山島・牛島（ウド）の「下水洞ビーチ」は、中央に露出した岩礁の海岸によって二つに分かれています。ビーチの総延長は約400mほどで、東側から約100mの地点と200m〜300mの地点には玄武岩の礁が露出しており、背後には砂丘層が発達しています。沿岸流によって運ばれた物質が堆積して形成されたビーチです。1970年代まで、伝統的な網を使ったカタクチイワシ漁が行われていました。
ja.pull_quote: ローカル推薦パートナー · 周辺の飲食店・安心宿舎連계コース
paragraphs: 済州島の東端・城山浦の北東海上にある火山島・牛島の「下水洞ビーチ」は、中央に露出した岩礁の海岸によって二つに分かれています。ビーチの総延長は約400mほどで、東側から約100mの地点と200m〜300mの地点には玄武岩の礁が露出しており、背後には砂丘層が発達しています。沿岸流によって運ばれた物質が堆積して形成されたビーチです。1970年代まで、伝統的な網を使ったカタクチイワシ漁が行われていました。
砂が柔らかく水深が浅いため、小さなお子様連れのご家族での海水浴に最適です。ビーチの周辺には民宿や飲食店があり、脱衣所、トイレなどの便宜施設があります。70代の海女をモチーフにした海女像が中央にあり、目を引きます。夏の夜には、漁船が灯した明かりが明るく照らします。

en.pull_quote: Located in Hallim-eup, Jeju-si, Geumneung Beach is directly connected to Hyeopjae Beach, a popular spot on the western coast. It features a sea that looks like dissolved blue paint...
paragraphs: Located in Hallim-eup, Jeju-si, Geumneung Beach is directly connected to Hyeopjae Beach, a popular spot on the western coast. While it shares a similar landscape with its neighboring beach—featuring a sea that looks like dissolved blue paint, the cute-shaped Biyangdo Island, and soft sandy shores—its charm lies in being less crowded and more leisurely. The parking lot connects directly to the beach, making it hassle-free to carry your belongings. The newly built shower facility is equipped with hot water showers for added convenience. When visiting this place, we recommend timing your visit to match the low tide.

When the seawater recedes far out, a wide, fine sandy beach is revealed. Natural pools with shallow depths, perfect for young children to play in, are formed in various spots. Seaweed and small sea snails left behind by the receding seawater naturally become toys for the children. Thanks to this, you can have a fun time even if you visit without any special preparation. However, since crushed seashell fragments are mixed with the sand at the beach entrance, wearing water shoes is strongly recommended. (Source: Visit Jeju Website)

paragraphs: 済州市翰林邑に位置する「金陵海水浴場」は、西の人気名所である協ジェ海水浴場とすぐにつながっています。青い絵の具を溶かしたような海から、形が可愛らしい飛揚島、感触のサラサラした砂浜まで、隣り合うビーチと似たような風景を抱いていますが、それほど人が混雑していないため、ゆったりとした雰囲気が魅力です。駐車場とビーチがすぐにつながっており、荷物を運ぶときも負担がありません。新しく新築されたシャワー室は温水シャワーが可能で、便利さが整っています。ここを訪れる際は、水が引く干潮時間に合わせて行くことをおすすめします。

海水が遠くまで引くと、広くてきめ細やかな砂浜が姿を現します。あちこちに水深が浅く、小さなお子様でも遊べる天然のプールが作られます。引いた海面が残していった海藻や小さなボマル（巻貝の一種）などは、自然と子供たちのおもちゃになります。おかげで何の準備なしに訪れても楽しく満喫することができます。ただし、ビーチの入り口に細かく砕けた貝殻が砂と混ざっているため、できれば水遊び用の靴の着用をおすすめします。（出典：ビジット済州ホームページ）

paragraphs: 位於濟州市翰林邑的「金陵海水浴場」與西側的人氣名勝協扎海灘直接相連。從彷彿打翻藍色顏料般的海洋、外形可愛的飛揚島，到觸感細緻的沙灘，這裡擁有與鄰近海灘相似的風景，但其魅力在於遊客較少，氛圍更加悠閒。停車場與海灘直接相連，搬運行李時毫無負擔。新建的淋浴間提供溫水淋浴，十分便利。造訪此處時，建議配合海水退潮的退潮時間前往。
當海水退到遠處時，會露出寬闊細緻的沙灘。各處形成了水深很淺、連幼童也能開心戲水的天然戲水池。退去的海水留下的海藻或小海螺等，自然而然成為孩子們的玩具。因此，即使沒有做任何準備前來也能玩得盡興。不過，由於海灘入口處參雜了碎小的貝殼碎片與沙子，建議盡量穿著戲水專用鞋。（出處：造訪濟州官網）

en.title: Sejong Travel White Paper: Green Relaxation Met in South Korea's Administrative Capital
en.subtitle: Sejong · A Smart Healing Web Edition Where Nature and City Harmonize
en.pull_quote: Experience a vibrant downtown healing journey encompassing the National Sejong Arboretum and Geumgang Pedestrian Bridge (Eungdari Bridge) in Sejong, the center of South Korea.
paragraphs:
【CHAPTER 1 · Representative Landmarks & Core History & Culture Course】
This course connects the Government Complex Sejong Rooftop Garden—where you can take in the center of South Korea at a glance—with Eungdari Bridge (Geumgang Pedestrian Bridge), South Korea's first double-deck pedestrian bridge. After exploring the grand-scale Presidential Archives, you can comfortably travel on foot or by vehicle to the National Hangul Museum, where you can feel the identity of a Hangeul cultural city named after King Sejong. For lunch, recharge your travel energy at nearby restaurants by tasting Sejong's light local delicacies such as freshwater shrimp spicy stew (minmulsaewu-maeuntang) or Korean beef bulgogi.

【CHAPTER 2 · Nature, Trekking & Drive Healing Route】
Indulge in a fresh green relaxation while strolling through the four-season greenhouses and various themed gardens at the National Sejong Arboretum, the largest urban-type arboretum in South Korea. At the adjoining Sejong Lake Park, you can enjoy light trekking along the Floating Stage Island and Wind Hill while admiring open waterfront scenery. Extend your drive to Bear Tree Park in Jeondong-myeon, where you can walk among Asiatic black bears and a 100,000-pyeong arboretum, completing perfect healing amidst nature.

【CHAPTER 3 · Local Gastronomy, Traditional Markets & Alley Tour】
Visit Jochiwon Traditional Market to encounter Sejong's living traditions and warm hospitality, fully experiencing the lively atmosphere of its 5-day periodic market. Enjoy an alley gastronomic exploration tasting market specialties such as multi-generational chicken tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes), savory padak (green onion fried chicken), and desserts made from fresh peaches grown in Sejong. Record precious memories of your Sejong trip over a leisurely cup of coffee at emotional cafe streets in Dajeong-dong and Naseong-dong, lined with local cafes.

【CHAPTER 4 · Night Views, Emotional Spots & Four-Season Festivals】
As dusk falls, ascend Eungdari Bridge, which dyes the Geumgang River in silver, and spend a romantic time appreciating dazzling media art and fantastic night views. During the Sejong Festival period every autumn, you can fully enjoy Sejong's unique festive atmosphere through fireworks shows and various Hangeul cultural experience programs unfolding around the Geumgang Lake Park area. The Bangchukcheon Music Fountain Square, where you can leave life-shot photos against the backdrop of a beautiful night view, is also an unmissable emotional spot.

【CHAPTER 5  · 2-Day 1-Night Recommended Stay Route & Legal Accommodation & Transportation Tips】
We recommend a fulfilling 2-day 1-night itinerary: Day 1 involves walking through the National Sejong Arboretum and Lake Park followed by viewing the night view of Eungdari Bridge; Day 2 continues with visiting Bear Tree Park and touring Jochiwon Traditional Market. For lodging, it is convenient to book in advance a business hotel near the Government Complex Sejong boasting clean facilities or a nature-friendly Hanok stay in Janggun-myeon. Utilizing BRT (Bus Rapid Transit) circulating downtown Sejong and 'Ooulling' public bicycles allows you to enjoy an eco-friendly yet economical urban trip.

ja.source_book: 世宗市公式観光案内地図 ＆ 樹木園・湖水公園お出かけ冊子
ja.title: 大韓民国行政中心都市で出会う緑の休息、世宗旅行白書
ja.subtitle: 世宗 · 自然と都市が調和するスマートヒーリングウェブエディション
ja.address: 世宗特別自治市韓ヌリ大路2130
ja.pull_quote: 大韓民国の中心である世宗で、国立世宗樹木園と錦江歩行橋（イウン橋）を網羅する多彩な都心のヒーリングの旅に出会ってみてください。
paragraphs:
【CHAPTER 1 · 代表ランドマーク ＆ 歴史・文化コアコース】
大韓民国の中心を一望できる政府世宗庁舎屋上庭園と、国内初の複層型歩行橋であるイウン橋（錦江歩行橋）を繋ぐコースです。雄大な規模の大統領記録館を巡った後、世宗大王の名を冠したハングル文化都市のアイデンティティを感じられるハングル博物館まで徒歩と車両で快適に移動できます。昼食には周辺の飲食店街で、淡泊な世宗の郷土料理である川エビの辛口鍋（ミムルセウメウンタン）や韓牛プルコギを味わい、旅のエネルギーを充電します。

【CHAPTER 2 · 自然・トレッキング・ドライブヒーリング動線】
国内最大規模の都心型樹木園である国立世宗樹木園で、四季折々の温室や様々なテーマ庭園を散策しながらフレッシュな緑の休息を満喫します。続く世宗湖水公園では、水上舞台島や風の丘に沿って軽いトレッキングを楽しみながら、開放感あふれる水辺の風景を鑑賞できます。全東面（チョンドンミョン）のベアートリーパークへドライブを広げ、ツキノワグマや10万坪の樹木園を歩きながら、自然の中で完璧なヒーリングを完成させます。

【CHAPTER 3 · ローカル美食・伝統市場・路地ツアー】
世宗の生き生きとした伝統と温かい人情に出会う鳥致院（チョチウォン）伝統市場を訪れ、5日市の活気ある雰囲気を全身で感じてみます。市場の名物である代々受け継がれてきた鶏トッポッキや香ばしいパダク（ネギ唐揚げ）、そして世宗で栽培された新鮮な桃で作ったデザートを味わう路地グルメ探訪を楽しみます。ローカルカフェが立ち並ぶ多情洞（タジョンドン）とナソン洞の感性カフェ通りで、ゆったりとしたコーヒー一杯とともに世宗旅行の大切な思い出を記録します。

【CHAPTER 4 · 夜景・感性スポット ＆ 四季折々の祭り】
夕暮れ時、錦江（クムガン）を銀色に染めるイウン橋の上に上がり、華麗なメディアアートと幻想的な夜景を鑑賞しながらロマンチックな時間を過ごします。毎年秋の世宗祭り期間には、錦江湖水公園一帯で繰り広げられる花火ショーや多彩なハングル文化体験プログラムを通じて、世宗ならではの特別な祭りの雰囲気を満喫できます。美しい夜景を背景に人生に残る写真が撮れる方築川（パンチュクチョン）音楽噴水広場も見逃せない感性スポットです。

【CHAPTER 5 · 1泊2日おすすめ滞在動線 ＆ 合法宿舎・交通のヒント】
1日目は国立世宗樹木園と湖水公園の散歩後、イウン橋の夜景観覧、2日目はベアートリーパーク訪問および鳥致院伝統市場ツアーへと続く充実した1泊2日の動線をおすすめします。宿舎は快適な施設を誇る政府世宗庁舎近隣のビジネスホテルや、自然に優しい将軍面（チャングンミョン）の韓屋（ハノック）ステイを事前に予約すると便利です。世宗市内を循環するBRT（幹出急行バス体制）や公共自転車「オウルリング」を活用すれば、環境に優しく経済的な都心旅行を楽しむことができます。

zh.title: 在韓國行政首都相遇的翠綠休憩，世宗旅遊白書
zh.subtitle: 世宗 · 自然與都市和諧相處的智慧療癒網路版
zh.address: 世宗特別自治市韓努里大路2130
zh.pull_quote: 在韓國的中心世宗，體驗涵蓋國立世宗植物園與錦江步行橋（圓樹橋）的豐富市區療癒之旅。
paragraphs:
【CHAPTER 1 · 代表地標與歷史文化核心路線】
這是一條將可一覽韓國中心的政府世宗廳舍屋頂庭園，與韓國首座複層式步行橋——圓樹橋（錦江步行橋）串聯起來的路線。參觀雄偉規模的總統紀錄館後，可步行或乘車舒適地前往以世宗大王命名的韓文文化城市身分認同之韓文博物館。午餐可在周邊餐廳品嚐清淡的世宗鄉土料理淡水蝦辣湯或韓牛烤肉，為旅程補充能量。

【CHAPTER 2 · 自然、健行與駕車療癒動線】
在韓國規模最大的都市型植物園——國立世宗植物園中，漫步於四季溫室與各種主題庭園，盡情享受清新的翠綠休憩。接著在鄰近的世宗湖水公園，沿著水上舞台島與風之丘享受輕鬆健行，欣賞開闊的水岸風光。將駕車路線延伸至全東面熊樹公園，在漫步於亞洲黑熊與十萬坪植物園之間，在自然中完成完美的療癒。

【CHAPTER 3 · 本地美食、傳統市場與巷弄導覽】
造訪充滿世宗活生生傳統與溫馨人情味鳥致院傳統市場，親身體驗5日集的熱鬧氛圍。享受巷弄美食探索，品嚐市場名物代代相傳的辣炒雞肉年糕、香酥蔥炸雞，以及使用世宗栽種的新鮮水蜜桃製作的甜點。在本地咖啡廳林立的多情洞與羅城洞的感性咖啡街，一邊享用悠閒的咖啡，一邊記錄世宗之旅的珍貴回憶。

【CHAPTER 4 · 夜景、感性景點與四季慶典】
黃昏時分，登上將錦江染成銀色的圓樹橋上，欣賞華麗的媒體藝術與夢幻夜景，度過浪漫的時光。每年秋季世宗慶典期間，透過在錦江湖水公園一帶展開的煙火秀與豐富的韓文文化體驗活動，盡情享受世宗專屬的特別慶典氛圍。以美麗夜景為背景留下人生美照的方築川音樂噴水廣場也是不可錯過的感性景點。

【CHAPTER 5 · 2天1夜推薦停留動線與合法住宿、交通小貼士】
第1天推薦國立世宗植物園與湖水公園散步後觀賞圓樹橋夜景，第2天造訪熊樹公園及鳥致院傳統市場的充實2天1夜動線。住宿方面，提前預約設施舒適的政府世宗廳舍附近商務飯店或親自然的將軍面韓屋民宿十分便利。利用循環世宗市內的BRT（幹線公車快捷運輸系統）與歐林公共自行車，即可享受環保又經濟的都市旅行。
